title: S&C GN - TS&T –Enterprise AI Value Strategy - Manager
description:
The work
Basic Requirements
•  Lead discovery workshops with business stakeholders to identify pain points, opportunities, and AI transformation use cases.
•  Design and articulate end-to-end agentic solution for enterprise process/functional use-cases — the agent hierarchy, target-state agentic architecture, value streams, agent interation models and transformation roadmaps. (with technical depth and agentic system build experience in 1 platform or functional area - GCP, AWS, Snowflake, DataBricks, Azure, Anthropic)
•  Assess enterprise data maturity, governance and technology readiness to shape scalable AI adoption.
•  Lead solution definition across business, architecture, data, and engineering teams while ensuring end-to-end traceability from business value to implementation.
•  Develop value framework for Agentic AI with the right industry/clinet context. Using the framework, build executive business cases including value estimation, investment requirements, KPIs, and benefits realization.
•  Drive business readiness and change management by defining stakeholder engagement, communication, training, and adoption plans for AI transformation initiatives.
Good to Have
•  Experience defining enterprise data strategies, data products, and AI-ready data foundations.
•  Exposure to knowledge architecture, semantic layers, and enterprise knowledge management.
•  Experience designing AI governance frameworks, operating models, and organizational readiness for AI adoption.
•  Strong consulting, executive communication, stakeholder management, and problem-structuring skills with experience leading cross-functional delivery teams.
Tech fluency
Deep in at least one platform (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake), or foundation models (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI). and broadly credible across all three categories. Can shape platform and model choices with a client's tech leadership.
Fluent enough in the agentic AI stack to judge where autonomous systems create real value versus hype, and to shape platform and model choices with a client's tech leadership.
Industry Lens:
Recognized depth in at least one priority industry (Consumer Goods, Retail, Life Sciences, Banking); knows its core processes well enough to challenge how they are run today and engage that C-suite credibly.
Role Summary
•  Min. 10 yrs overall, incl. AI & data projects
•  High-value consulting; large-scale delivery with minimal oversight
•  Has led at least one end-to-end process reengineering or reinvention engagement
•  Process modelling and requirements definition at enterprise scale
•  Manages senior stakeholders
•  Awareness of AI governance and regulation (e.g., EU AI Act, model risk)
•  Structured problem-solving; program management; strong communication
Qualifications & Certifications
• Bachelor's degree (relevant discipline); MBA preferred
What’s in it for you?
• An opportunity to work on transformative projects with key G2000 clients
• Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
• Ability to embed responsible business into everything—from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
• Personalized training modules to develop your strategy & consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
• Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

title: EH-FY27-Consulting-S&T-Strategy-Senior Consultant-TS-AI Strategy
description:
Summary
 Position Summary 
 Strategy & Transactions - SFL Scientific– AI Strategy ( Senior Consultant) 
At Deloitte Strategy & Transactions (S&T), we don’t just advise — we architect the future. Our team is uniquely positioned at the intersection of strategy and execution, empowering clients to tackle their most pressing challenges and unlock transformative growth. SFL Scientific is part of Deloitte’s AI strategy, data science, and engineering practice. We help clients move beyond pilots by shaping enterprise AI ambition, prioritizing high-value use cases, designing AI operating models and governance, and partnering with technical teams to scale AI solutions that deliver measurable business value.
We serve as trusted advisors to our clients, working with them to make clear data-driven choices, using the state-of-the-art technologies, to advise our clients on how to leverage AI technologies and working directly with them to design , implement and scale novel solutions that drive value.
But we don’t stop at client impact. We are equally passionate about investing in our people. In S&T, you’ll be part of a dynamic team culture that accelerates leadership development, fosters curiosity, and delivers hands-on experience at the forefront of strategy and transactions. You'll have the opportunity to work across industries, engage directly with senior client stakeholders, and develop expertise at the intersection of strategy, AI, and business transformation.
If you’re looking to work where bold thinking meets real-world impact and where your growth matters as much as your clients’ Strategy & Transactions is your next move.
 The team 
• Our Strategy practice brings together business strategists, AI specialists, data scientists, engineers, and transformation advisors to help clients move from AI ambition to measurable enterprise value. We work with clients to identify where AI can create advantage, shape AI and data strategy, design scalable operating models, and partner with technical teams to bring priority AI and data science initiatives to life.
Strategy professionals serve as trusted advisors to our clients, helping them make clear, data-driven choices about where to play, how to win, and how to scale AI responsibly across the enterprise.
 Work you will do: 
Deloitte’s ‘Strategy’ offering helps companies address the entire range of top management challenges including pursuing new growth opportunities, developing go-to-market strategies, and driving enterprise transformation. As an AI Strategy Consultant, you will:
•  Provide strategic directions to clients on how to leverage Artificial Intelligence (including Generative AI) to drive innovation, competitive advantage, and enterprise value. 
•  Work with C-suite stakeholders to define AI strategy, vision, and transformation roadmaps, aligned to business priorities and market context. 
•  Identify and prioritize high-impact AI and GenAI use cases, develop business cases, and define value realization pathways. 
•  Bring a strong understanding of how AI solutions are developed and deployed in enterprise environments to ground strategic recommendations in practical feasibility. 
•  Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for AI features from problem framing and requirements definition through sprint delivery, UAT, launch, and post-launch iteration. 
•  Define detailed product requirements for AI/ML features specifying model inputs/outputs, confidence thresholds, fallback behaviors, latency requirements, and human-in-the-loop escalation paths. 
•  Understand, decide and communicate business and technical decisions and trade-offs and decisions to client stakeholders. 
•  Support clients in shaping AI-enabled products, services, and business models, including commercialization and go-to-market considerations. 
•  Redesign customer and operational workflows by embedding AI into business processes and decision-making. 
•  Partner with data scientists and ML engineers to define data schemas, feature requirements, and evaluation frameworks; contribute to decisions on model selection, fine-tuning vs. prompting, and deployment approach. 
•  Support the planning and execution of AI transformation initiatives by coordinating cross-functional teams, managing stakeholder alignment, tracking key milestones, and helping drive delivery of business outcomes. 
Required Experience And Skills
 Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy (AI Strategy) 
•  – Experience in defining AI strategies, identifying high-value use cases, and building value creation roadmaps aligned to business priorities. 
•  – Ability to translate business problems into AI/GenAI opportunities, including use case identification, feasibility assessment, and ROI estimation. 
•  – Exposure to GenAI concepts (e.g., LLMs, copilots, intelligent automation) and their application across business functions. 
•  - Understanding data foundations required for scalable AI adoption, AI/ML algorithm development workflow and data analysis, time-series analysis, computer vision with an emphasis on generative AI and Large Language Models 
•  – Experience owning AI-powered features end-to-end, including writing PRDs for ML systems, managing AI product backlogs, and coordinating delivery across product, engineering, and data science. 
•  – Experience supporting technology, data, analytics, automation, or AI-enabled initiatives in a professional setting, with the ability to apply this understanding to real-world enterprise constraints, delivery considerations, and change adoption. 
 Core Consulting 
•  Clear and concise communication - conduct client interviews, participate in workshops/trainings and present recommendations.
•  Lead product discovery sessions, write and refine requirements with engineering, run sprint reviews, and communicate AI system behavior and limitations to non-technical stakeholders.
•  Good client presence – interact and build relationships with clients and other team members.
•  Analytical thinking - ability to perform detailed, quantitative analysis and research (primary and secondary). Synthesize and present insights and recommendations from data.
•  Logical structuring - structured approach to problem solving and ability to perform root cause analysis of client problems.
•  Deadline-oriented and quality focused - develop and own development of deliverables. own and manage specific work-thread, develop plans for components of engagement, manage and mentor junior resources.
•  Collaboration - Be able to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels. Be able to prioritize tasks, manage change in scope, work on multiple assignments, and raise concerns/questions where appropriate.
•  Networking - Ability to chart one’s own career and build networks within the organization.
Qualifications
 Required: 
•  MBA from a premier institution in India or abroad
•  Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (B.Tech), preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related disciplines
•  4+ years (for Senior Consultants) of relevant experience in roles involving AI strategy, AI product management, AI-enabled digital transformation, data & AI initiatives, or enterprise programs focused on leveraging Artificial Intelligence (including Generative AI) to drive business value
•  Strong problem-solving, communication, stakeholder management, and analytical skills
•  Ability to work effectively with business stakeholders, data scientists, AI engineers, and product teams.
 Preferred: 
•  Prior consulting, strategy, transformation, product management, or technology advisory experience
•  Exposure to AI strategy, Generative AI, AI operating models, AI governance, AI product development, or AI transformation programs
•  Experience working with global stakeholders and cross-functional teams
•  Familiarity with cloud, data, analytics, and AI ecosystems (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP)
•  Relevant certifications in AI, Data, Cloud, or Analytics (e.g., Azure AI Fundamentals, Azure Data Fundamentals, AWS AI/ML certifications, Google Cloud AI certifications, Power BI, Tableau, TOGAF, or equivalent)
Our purpose
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
Our people and culture
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
Professional development
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
Benefits To Help You Thrive
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
Recruiting tips
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: I&P GN - SC&E – Consultant - Enterprise AI Value Strategy-EVS
description:
You are curious about how artificial intelligence is reshaping the way global supply chains are designed, planned, and operated. You understand that the future of supply chain is not just about automation — it's about intelligent systems that learn, adapt, and collaborate. You bring a blend of functional supply chain knowledge and a growing fluency in enterprise AI concepts, and you're energized by the challenge of turning that combination into tangible value for clients.
You're comfortable moving between structured analysis and open-ended problem-solving. You ask good questions, synthesize complex information quickly, and communicate your thinking clearly — whether you're mapping a demand-planning process, drafting a functional specification, or helping a client imagine what an AI-powered supply chain could look like. You're eager to grow, take direction well, and understand that great consulting outcomes are built on meticulous preparation and disciplined thinking.
THE WORK
Utilize relevant AI tools across all tasks and deliverable creation, including the creation of agents and other tools to help facilitate:
Supply Chain AI Strategy & Use Case Development
• Identify, assess, and prioritize AI use cases across supply chain domains — Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Aftermarket, and Fulfillment — by mapping current-state processes to AI-enabled future states. 
• Support the development of Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs) grounded in supply chain functional knowledge and client-specific context. 
• Contribute to AI reference architecture designs tailored for supply chain environments, illustrating how agentic AI components interact with enterprise data platforms, ERP systems, and planning tools. 
• Assist in crafting AI value cases and business cases that articulate ROI, risk, and transformation timelines for supply chain-specific AI initiatives. 
Client Engagement & Advisory Support
• Support client workshops and discovery sessions by preparing materials, capturing requirements, and synthesizing stakeholder inputs across supply chain functions. 
• Prepare client-facing presentations, roadmaps, and strategy decks that translate AI and data concepts into accessible narratives for supply chain and operations leaders. 
• Apply Design Thinking principles to facilitate structured problem definition and solution ideation sessions with client teams. 
• Maintain and evolve the team's repository of supply chain AI frameworks, benchmarks, and industry case examples. 
Data & AI Foundations
• Develop foundational fluency in enterprise data concepts — data products, data pipelines, and agentic AI hierarchies — as they apply to supply chain planning and execution systems. 
• Support data analysis tasks to surface insights from supply chain datasets (e.g., forecast accuracy, inventory performance, supplier scorecards) in service of client recommendations. 
• Explore and apply prompt engineering and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) techniques to build or enhance AI tools that support supply chain advisory workflows. 
• Complete assigned AI literacy and continuous-learning modules, contributing to a culture of applied innovation within the team.

• Shape end-to-end AI solutions, commercial models, and go-to-market strategies that align with business objectives and industry priorities.
• Drive thought leadership, industry-specific AI narratives, and strategic growth initiatives across the APJ region.
Work model: Work from Office
At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible, and we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is an onsite position requiring working in a client or Cognizant office in APJ.
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.

• Extensive CXO engagement experience, with the ability to facilitate executive workshops, influence senior stakeholders, and present complex AI concepts in business terms.
• Strong business case and value-realisation skills, including development of ROI models, investment cases, cost-benefit analyses, and executive funding proposals.
• Experience developing AI roadmaps and transformation strategies from opportunity identification and use-case prioritisation through to enterprise-scale implementation.

These will help you stand out
• Experience defining AI operating models, governance frameworks, and Responsible AI programs.

description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Job Description
Associate Director
AI Strategy
EY-Parthenon | EY Global Delivery Services (GDS)
Role Overview
EY GDS is seeking a highly experienced Associate Director – AI Strategy to lead the development and execution of AI-led business transformation engagements within EY-Parthenon’s global strategy consulting practice.
This role sits at the intersection of strategy, artificial intelligence, generative AI, data analytics, digital transformation and value creation. The Associate Director will partner with global EY-Parthenon leadership and client executives to shape enterprise AI strategies, identify growth and efficiency opportunities, establish AI governance frameworks and deliver large-scale AI transformation programmes.
The individual will play a critical role in building EY-Parthenon’s AI Strategy capabilities across GDS while supporting client pursuits, thought leadership, innovation initiatives and high-impact transformation engagements.
Key Responsibilities
AI Strategy & Enterprise Transformation
• Lead AI strategy engagements for Fortune 500 and private equity-backed organisations across sectors.
• Advise C-suite executives on AI-enabled growth, operating model transformation, productivity enhancement and innovation opportunities.
• Develop enterprise AI and Generative AI roadmaps aligned to business and value creation objectives.
• Conduct AI maturity assessments and identify capability gaps across people, process, technology and governance.
• Define target operating models for AI adoption at enterprise scale.
• Support post-merger integration and value creation programmes through AI-enabled business transformation.
Generative AI & Agentic AI Advisory
• Identify, prioritise and evaluate AI, GenAI and Agentic AI use cases.
• Design AI-driven value realisation frameworks and business cases.
• Advise clients on Large Language Models (LLMs), AI platforms, intelligent automation, digital workers and emerging technologies.
• Support enterprise-wide GenAI adoption strategies and scaling approaches.
• Collaborate with technology teams to translate strategy into execution roadmaps.
AI Governance, Risk & Responsible AI
• Design and implement Responsible AI frameworks.
• Establish AI governance models, controls, policies and oversight mechanisms.
• Assess AI-related risks including data privacy, cybersecurity, model bias, explainability and regulatory compliance.
• Support clients in developing Trusted AI and AI assurance programmes.
• Advise executive stakeholders on emerging AI regulations and industry best practices.
Private Equity & Value Creation Support
• Partner with EY-Parthenon value creation teams to identify AI-enabled EBITDA improvement opportunities.
• Support commercial due diligence and technology diligence engagements from an AI perspective.
• Develop AI-led transformation opportunities for portfolio companies.
• Identify opportunities for cost optimisation, process automation and operational efficiency.
Business Development & Market Leadership
• Lead proposal development and client presentations.
• Support account growth and strategic pursuit initiatives.
• Build reusable AI strategy methodologies, assets and accelerators.
• Publish thought leadership, white papers and market insights.
• Represent EY-Parthenon at industry forums and client events.
Leadership & People Development
• Lead multidisciplinary teams of strategy consultants, data scientists, AI specialists and transformation professionals.
• Coach and mentor Managers, Senior Managers and Consultants.
• Drive capability development within the AI Strategy practice.
• Support recruitment, workforce planning and talent development initiatives.
• Foster an innovation-led and collaborative culture across global teams.
Expected Scope of Responsibility
• Independently manage multiple large consulting engagements.
• Own senior client relationships and executive stakeholder interactions.
• Drive complex workstreams with minimal Partner oversight.
• Contribute to practice revenue growth.
• Build scalable AI consulting capabilities across EY GDS.
• Collaborate with global EY-Parthenon, Consulting, Technology, Data & Analytics and EY.ai teams.
Essential
Preferred Experience
• 15+ years of consulting, strategy, technology, analytics or digital transformation experience.
• 5+ years leading enterprise-scale AI, analytics or transformation programmes.
• Demonstrated experience working with C-suite stakeholders.
• Strong understanding of strategic planning and business transformation.
• Experience leading global delivery and distributed teams.
Preferred
• Experience in strategy consulting firms such as EY-Parthenon, EY Consulting, MBB, Big Four, Accenture Strategy, Kearney, Strategy& or equivalent.
• Experience supporting Private Equity, Corporate Strategy or Value Creation engagements.
• Experience with Generative AI, Agentic AI, Large Language Models, AI governance, data strategy, advanced analytics, intelligent automation, digital workforce solutions and cloud-based AI platforms.
Qualifications
Education
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, Data Science, Statistics, Business or a related discipline.
Preferred Qualifications
• MBA from a reputed institution.
• Master’s degree in AI, Data Science, Analytics, Technology Management or a related field.
• Professional certifications in AI, Cloud, Analytics or Agile methodologies.
Key Competencies
Capability Area - Expected Competencies
Strategic Leadership - Enterprise strategy development; market assessment and competitive analysis; value creation planning; executive stakeholder management
AI & Emerging Technology - AI strategy; Generative AI; AI governance; digital transformation; data and analytics strategy; AI operating models
Consulting Excellence - Structured problem-solving; engagement leadership; workshop facilitation; executive storytelling; financial and business case modelling
Commercial Acumen - Revenue generation; proposal leadership; account management; practice building
Success Measures
Client Outcomes
• Successful delivery of AI Strategy engagements
• Client satisfaction and relationship growth
• Quantifiable business value realised for clients
Commercial Performance
• Sales and pipeline contribution
• Proposal conversion rate
• Account expansion and revenue growth
Practice Development
• AI strategy capability development
• Thought leadership contributions
• Development of reusable methodologies and offerings
People Leadership
• Team engagement and retention
• Coaching and talent development
• Leadership effectiveness
Ideal EY GDS Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate combines the strategic thinking of an EY-Parthenon consultant with the practical AI transformation experience of a technology leader. They will have a proven track record of shaping AI-enabled business strategies, driving executive alignment, building governance frameworks, developing AI-driven value creation opportunities and leading globally distributed consulting teams to deliver measurable business outcomes.
EY | Building a better working world 
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
Summary
 Position Summary 
 Strategy & Transactions - SFL Scientific– AI Strategy ( Senior Consultant) 
At Deloitte Strategy & Transactions (S&T), we don’t just advise — we architect the future. Our team is uniquely positioned at the intersection of strategy and execution, empowering clients to tackle their most pressing challenges and unlock transformative growth. SFL Scientific is part of Deloitte’s AI strategy, data science, and engineering practice. We help clients move beyond pilots by shaping enterprise AI ambition, prioritizing high-value use cases, designing AI operating models and governance, and partnering with technical teams to scale AI solutions that deliver measurable business value.
We serve as trusted advisors to our clients, working with them to make clear data-driven choices, using the state-of-the-art technologies, to advise our clients on how to leverage AI technologies and working directly with them to design , implement and scale novel solutions that drive value.
But we don’t stop at client impact. We are equally passionate about investing in our people. In S&T, you’ll be part of a dynamic team culture that accelerates leadership development, fosters curiosity, and delivers hands-on experience at the forefront of strategy and transactions. You'll have the opportunity to work across industries, engage directly with senior client stakeholders, and develop expertise at the intersection of strategy, AI, and business transformation.
If you’re looking to work where bold thinking meets real-world impact and where your growth matters as much as your clients’ Strategy & Transactions is your next move.
 The team 
• Our Strategy practice brings together business strategists, AI specialists, data scientists, engineers, and transformation advisors to help clients move from AI ambition to measurable enterprise value. We work with clients to identify where AI can create advantage, shape AI and data strategy, design scalable operating models, and partner with technical teams to bring priority AI and data science initiatives to life.
Strategy professionals serve as trusted advisors to our clients, helping them make clear, data-driven choices about where to play, how to win, and how to scale AI responsibly across the enterprise.
 Work you will do: 
Deloitte’s ‘Strategy’ offering helps companies address the entire range of top management challenges including pursuing new growth opportunities, developing go-to-market strategies, and driving enterprise transformation. As an AI Strategy Consultant, you will:
•  Provide strategic directions to clients on how to leverage Artificial Intelligence (including Generative AI) to drive innovation, competitive advantage, and enterprise value. 
•  Work with C-suite stakeholders to define AI strategy, vision, and transformation roadmaps, aligned to business priorities and market context. 
•  Identify and prioritize high-impact AI and GenAI use cases, develop business cases, and define value realization pathways. 
•  Bring a strong understanding of how AI solutions are developed and deployed in enterprise environments to ground strategic recommendations in practical feasibility. 
•  Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for AI features from problem framing and requirements definition through sprint delivery, UAT, launch, and post-launch iteration. 
•  Define detailed product requirements for AI/ML features specifying model inputs/outputs, confidence thresholds, fallback behaviors, latency requirements, and human-in-the-loop escalation paths. 
•  Understand, decide and communicate business and technical decisions and trade-offs and decisions to client stakeholders. 
•  Support clients in shaping AI-enabled products, services, and business models, including commercialization and go-to-market considerations. 
•  Redesign customer and operational workflows by embedding AI into business processes and decision-making. 
•  Partner with data scientists and ML engineers to define data schemas, feature requirements, and evaluation frameworks; contribute to decisions on model selection, fine-tuning vs. prompting, and deployment approach. 
•  Support the planning and execution of AI transformation initiatives by coordinating cross-functional teams, managing stakeholder alignment, tracking key milestones, and helping drive delivery of business outcomes. 
Required Experience And Skills
 Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy (AI Strategy) 
•  – Experience in defining AI strategies, identifying high-value use cases, and building value creation roadmaps aligned to business priorities. 
•  – Ability to translate business problems into AI/GenAI opportunities, including use case identification, feasibility assessment, and ROI estimation. 
•  – Exposure to GenAI concepts (e.g., LLMs, copilots, intelligent automation) and their application across business functions. 
•  - Understanding data foundations required for scalable AI adoption, AI/ML algorithm development workflow and data analysis, time-series analysis, computer vision with an emphasis on generative AI and Large Language Models 
•  – Experience owning AI-powered features end-to-end, including writing PRDs for ML systems, managing AI product backlogs, and coordinating delivery across product, engineering, and data science. 
•  – Experience supporting technology, data, analytics, automation, or AI-enabled initiatives in a professional setting, with the ability to apply this understanding to real-world enterprise constraints, delivery considerations, and change adoption. 
 Core Consulting 
•  Clear and concise communication - conduct client interviews, participate in workshops/trainings and present recommendations.
•  Lead product discovery sessions, write and refine requirements with engineering, run sprint reviews, and communicate AI system behavior and limitations to non-technical stakeholders.
•  Good client presence – interact and build relationships with clients and other team members.
•  Analytical thinking - ability to perform detailed, quantitative analysis and research (primary and secondary). Synthesize and present insights and recommendations from data.
•  Logical structuring - structured approach to problem solving and ability to perform root cause analysis of client problems.
•  Deadline-oriented and quality focused - develop and own development of deliverables. own and manage specific work-thread, develop plans for components of engagement, manage and mentor junior resources.
•  Collaboration - Be able to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels. Be able to prioritize tasks, manage change in scope, work on multiple assignments, and raise concerns/questions where appropriate.
•  Networking - Ability to chart one’s own career and build networks within the organization.
Qualifications
 Required: 
•  MBA from a premier institution in India or abroad
•  Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (B.Tech), preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related disciplines
•  4+ years (for Senior Consultants) of relevant experience in roles involving AI strategy, AI product management, AI-enabled digital transformation, data & AI initiatives, or enterprise programs focused on leveraging Artificial Intelligence (including Generative AI) to drive business value
•  Strong problem-solving, communication, stakeholder management, and analytical skills
•  Ability to work effectively with business stakeholders, data scientists, AI engineers, and product teams.
 Preferred: 
•  Prior consulting, strategy, transformation, product management, or technology advisory experience
•  Exposure to AI strategy, Generative AI, AI operating models, AI governance, AI product development, or AI transformation programs
•  Experience working with global stakeholders and cross-functional teams
•  Familiarity with cloud, data, analytics, and AI ecosystems (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP)
•  Relevant certifications in AI, Data, Cloud, or Analytics (e.g., Azure AI Fundamentals, Azure Data Fundamentals, AWS AI/ML certifications, Google Cloud AI certifications, Power BI, Tableau, TOGAF, or equivalent)
Our purpose
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
Our people and culture
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
Professional development
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
Benefits To Help You Thrive
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
Recruiting tips

title: Applied Value Engineer - EAM-EMEA
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
The Role:
• As an Applied Value Engineer(EAM) you are pushing the envelope in solving business-critical problems for our customers. You will be working with our most strategic customers, understanding their objectives and key challenges, and building Celonis solutions using the world’s leading Process Intelligence (PI) platform in combination with the largest AI and ML technology partners, such as Microsoft, OpenAI and Databricks. With Celonis’ Process Intelligence (PI) platform we feed operational context to AI so it understands our customers’ business and enables them to industrialize AI unlocking real ROI on AI deployments and at scale. There is no AI without PI. You will prototype these solutions, demonstrate their value to Executives and ensure successful implementation, adoption and value realization in order to increase the footprint of Celonis at those customers.
The work you’ll do:
• AI Discovery & Solutioning: Understand customers AI strategy and business critical challenges. As Celonis product & domain expert, find the best problem-solution fit and translate customer requirements into innovative solutions that move the needle.
• Hackathons & Prototyping: Rapidly build creative prototypes (LLM/Agent-based) to solve business-critical problems during customer hackathons. Agentic Process Transformation: Enable a fundamental shift for our customers from traditional automation to autonomous AI agents empowered by the Celonis PI Platform.
• Proof Projects: Execute end-to-end Proof-of-Value (PoV) projects, including architecture, RAG, and guardrails, ensuring compliance with enterprise data and identity frameworks.
• Identify & Frame Value: Discover and translate customers’ strategic priorities into high-impact Celonis use cases Build demos and business cases, leveraging industry benchmarks and best practices in order to win new customers Undertake Value Assessments or Proof-of-Value Projects and communicate the value opportunity and strategic roadmap to C-Level executives
• Realize Value: Facilitate business value workshops and use Celonis to identify and qualify opportunities for process enhancement Derive improvement measures in core business functions and initiate improvement actions and enterprise-wide change initiatives Present results and realized value to senior management and C-level executives
• Scale Value: Responsible for the end-to-end customer value journey, landing, expanding, adoption and renewing Build a strategic expansion roadmap for customers embedding Celonis Process Intelligence as a strategic business transformation platform in their organization and therefore drive adoption and expansion Provide feedback to our product development teams to enhance the Celonis platform and Apps based on new use case
The qualifications you need:
• Live for Customer Value: 4+ years of experience in an analytical role with the objective to demonstrate or secure value through business data analysis, business process improvement and respective Software deployment. Ideally in a customer-facing role in Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering or IT/Management Consulting with a Business Software / SaaS Provider or a Consultancy. Alternatively in an Inhouse role (e.g. Center of Excellence for Data Mining / Analytics / Intelligence) within an Enterprise. Data, Analytics, Applications & IT: Good knowledge of Business Software / SaaS applications (e.g. SAP/ Oracle), experience with implementing RPA and/or BI Tools and/or building Dashboards, Apps and Action Flows. Hands-on Experience with Process Mining tools and technologies is preferred. 
• Hands-on Python, AI building and consulting experience mandate. 
• Process Improvement & Value Realization: Experience in identifying business use cases for business process improvement and deploying improvement measures, being a change agent and training users/process owners to realize value. Domain and industry knowledge such as Supply chain, finance, CPG, BFSI, Manufacturing etc. would be a plus.
• Project Management: Experience in planning and managing project scopes, expectations and timelines. You will manage multiple projects across your aligned accounts that will be at different parts of the value journey. Also, you will leverage partners from the Celonis Ecosystem wherever possible.
• Executive Stakeholder Management: Experience in preparing and communicating (value) roadmaps and results to stakeholders and management, both internally and externally. Excellent communication and presentation skills in English.
• Automotive and Manufacturing is a plus.
Nice to have (big plus):
• Hands-on experience building agentic systems using LLM orchestration, RAG, function calling, and prompt engineering, while ensuring safety through rigorous evaluations and guardrails.
• Working knowledge of tools in the LLM ecosystem such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or other OSS packages.
• Experience in deploying and monitoring models at scale across major cloud platforms (AWS Bedrock, Azure AI, GCP Vertex)
What Celonis can offer you:
• Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
• Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time Celonaut is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
• Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
• Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
• Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
• Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated Wellness Weeks that prioritize work/life balance.
• Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
• Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
• Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.
About Us:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.
Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.
Celonis Inclusion Statement:
At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

title: Solutions Manager
description:
Job Description 
We are looking for a high-impact Solution Manager to anchor our CPG portfolio's pre-sales and solutioning engine. This is a client-facing, commercially oriented role where you will own the end-to end solutioning lifecycle from discovery and shaping proposals, pricing, and executive storytelling-for US-based CPG clients. You will partner closely with our Sales, Delivery, and CoE teams to craft differentiated, insight-led solutions in AI/ML, GenAI, and Analytics-translating complex technical capabilities into compelling client narratives and winning proposals.
Key Responsibilities 
• Pre-Sales & Solutioning: 
o Own the solutioning process for CPG accounts across RFPs, RFIs, proactive proposals, and capability pitches targeting US market clients.
o Lead client discovery workshops and structured intake sessions to elicit business problems, define success metrics, and translate them into solution blueprints.
o Architect AI/ML, GenAI, and analytics solutions aligned to CPG-specific use cases (e.g., demand forecasting, RGM, trade promotion optimization, supply chain AI, consumer intelligence).
o Structure POC / prototype scopes with clear problem framing, success criteria, effort estimates, and commercial hypotheses.
o Build and own proposal narratives-from executive summaries and solution architecture to delivery approach, team structure, and commercial constructs.
• Executive Storytelling & Client Engagement:
o Design and deliver high-quality executive presentations for C-suite and VP-level stakeholders at CPG clients.
o Craft differentiated points of view (POVs) and thought leadership content that position MathCo as the preferred AI partner for CPG enterprises.
o Represent MathCo in client-facing meetings, workshops, and orals-acting as a trusted advisor and solution expert. Internal Use Only
• Commercial & Cross-functional Collaboration:
o Partner with Account Managers/ Customer Success Leader in US and Mining & Farming leads for Vertical growth to develop account strategies, pipeline plans, and pursuit roadmaps for key CPG clients.
o Work closely with CoE leads, Delivery Managers, and practice heads to ensure solutions are technically grounded, deliverable, and commercially viable.
• Contribute to pricing, effort estimation, and deal structuring in coordination with finance and delivery stakeholders.
o Support internal capability building-contributing to reusable proposal assets, solution accelerators, and CPG-specific IP.
Required Skills and Experience
• Experience:
o 6+ years of overall experience in data, analytics, or AI/ML consulting or product roles.
o Minimum 2 years in dedicated Pre-Sales, Solutioning, or Solution Architecture capacity owning proposals and client pitches end-to-end.
o Demonstrated track record of winning engagements with US-based enterprise clients, ideally in CPG (Food & Beverage, Household Products, Tobacco & Spirits, or broad CPG).
• Domain & Technical Knowledge:
o Strong understanding of CPG value chain-commercial, supply chain, marketing, and manufacturing domains.
o Hands-on fluency with AI/ML concepts: predictive modelling, NLP, computer vision, recommendation systems, and GenAI/LLM applications.
o Familiarity with analytics and data platforms: cloud data stacks (Azure / AWS / GCP), BI tools, and modern data architectures (Lakehouse, Data Fabric, Semantic Layer).
o Ability to scope GenAI and agentic AI solutions-including RAG architectures, AI agents, and enterprise LLM deployment patterns.
• Pre-Sales & Solutioning Skills:
o Proven ability to lead RFP / RFI responses-structuring win themes, differentiators, and solution narratives under tight deadlines.
o Experience designing POC scopes with clear hypotheses, deliverables, and success metrics that de-risk larger engagements.
o Strong commercial acumen-comfortable with effort estimation, pricing models, and deal shaping conversations.
o Executive-level communication and presentation skills; able to engage and influence senior stakeholders confidently.
• Soft Skills & Mindset:
o Entrepreneurial, self-starter mindset-comfortable operating in ambiguity and building structure where none exists.
o Strong collaboration skills; able to work across time zones with US-based clients and internal global teams.
o High ownership orientation treats client outcomes as personal accountability, not just delivery responsibility.
o Excellent written and verbal communication in English; ability to simplify complex AI concepts for non-technical audiences.
• Good to Have:
o Prior experience at a global analytics / AI consulting firm with a dedicated CPG vertical.
o Familiarity with US CPG market dynamics-key players, regulatory environment, and digital maturity trends.
o Experience with agentic AI frameworks and enterprise AI platform deployments (e.g., Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Databricks).
o MBA or advanced degree in a PLUS in any one of the disciplines (Engineering, Statistics, Computer Science, Business Analytics)

title: Cloud Solution Architecture
description:
Overview
Overview
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
With a vision to "Build and sell Microsoft AI, Cloud applications, services, and devices with partners, empowering people and organizations to achieve more," SME&C Channel Partner Sales (GCPS) is responsible for driving revenue outcomes with partners through innovative solutions–at scale. This is where the Global Cross Solutions Partner Solution Architect plays a pivotal role.
As a Global Cross-Solution Partner Architect, you will shape and drive Microsoft’s technical strategy with our most strategic Global Channel partners. You will act as a senior technical advisor to partner executives, helping them build scalable, secure, AI-enabled services and solutions across Copilot, Agents, Azure, Security, Data & Fabric, Infrastructure, and Modern Work.
This role is focused on helping partners transform into AI-first, services-led businesses by aligning their technical roadmaps, Centers of Excellence, factories, practices, and offers to Microsoft’s cloud and AI priorities. You will guide partners from strategy to execution, ensuring their capabilities translate into repeatable, market-ready offerings that drive customer adoption, consumption, usage, and measurable business impact.
You will work across partner CTOs, services leaders, architects, Microsoft field teams, engineering, product groups, and sales organizations to connect global strategy with local execution. Success in this role requires strong technical credibility, executive influence, cross-solution thinking, and the ability to turn partner ambition into scalable services-led outcomes.
Responsibilities
Responsibilities
Global Partner Technical Strategy & Transformation
• Serve as the global technical owner for partner transformation, aligning their technology roadmaps with Microsoft’s Cloud and AI priorities.
• Help partners build and mature CoEs, factories, practices, and offers that scale Microsoft-based services and guide them in becoming AI-first, services-led businesses with repeatable, differentiated solution offerings and managed services.
Cloud Transformation Leadership
• Lead partners globally through large-scale cloud transformation journeys, challenging conventional thinking and championing innovation.
• Drive consistent frameworks and best practices that accelerate time-to-market and ensure global scalability.
Innovation & Tech Intensity
• Act as a global thought leader, staying at the forefront of emerging technologies such as generative AI, agentic AI, cloud-native architectures, and advanced security frameworks.
• Inspire partners to embrace tech intensity, experimenting with cutting-edge solutions that differentiate their services in the market.
Strategic Relationships & Influence
• Build trusted, long-term relationships with partner CTOs, executives, and technical leaders across regions.
• Act as a global trusted advisor, guiding technology roadmaps that scale worldwide while tailoring approaches to local markets.
Leadership & Collaboration
• Partner with Microsoft’s worldwide, regional, and engineering teams to ensure consistent technical strategy landing across geographies.
• Influence Microsoft’s product roadmaps by representing partner requirements and global market signals back to engineering.
Strategy Formulation & Communication
• Develop and articulate long-term global partner technology strategies that integrate across solution areas.
• Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and executive stakeholders worldwide.
Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and executive stakeholders worldwide.
Qualifications
Qualifications 
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field AND 8+ years in technical consulting, architecture, or strategy roles
OR equivalent professional experience.
• 10+ years of relevant experience in solution architecture, technical strategy, or partner technology leadership at a global or enterprise scale.
• Proven expertise in multiple solution areas (e.g., Cloud Infrastructure, AI, Security, Data & Analytics, Modern Work).
• Strong track record of influencing C-level executives and shaping partner roadmaps at scale.
• Deep understanding of Microsoft cloud platforms (Azure, Dynamics 365, Microsoft 365) with experience in cloud architecture, migration, and optimization.
• Experience leading global technical programs or engagements, balancing central strategy with regional execution.
• Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to simplify complex concepts and use storytelling/analogies to drive clarity.

title: Solution Engineering
description:
Overview
our purpose is to empower organizations to transform the way they work by harnessing the full potential of artificial intelligence. We guide customers through the evolving digital landscape, enabling them to unlock new opportunities, enhance productivity, and deliver exceptional employee and customer experiences. By integrating advanced AI capabilities across devices, cloud platforms, and everyday business applications, we help organizations realize seamless, innovative, and secure solutions that drive sustained growth and success in the AI era.
As a Solution Engineer in the AI Business Solutions – Copilot team, you will lead technical engagements that drive AI transformation for enterprise customers. Your mission is to win technical decisions and accelerate adoption of Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, Copilot Studio & Agents, and related solutions by delivering compelling demos, envisioning sessions, and scalable architectures. You will act as a trusted advisor, guiding customers through secure, compliant, and value-driven implementations that align with their enterprise strategies.
This role is pivotal in shaping the future of work by enabling customers to realize the full potential of AI-powered productivity. You will collaborate closely with sales, customer success, engineering, and partner teams to remove technical blockers, generate pipeline, and ensure seamless handoffs for deployment and adoption. Your success will be measured by technical wins, customer adoption, partner engagement, and your contributions to a high-performance, learning-oriented team culture

title: MLEU – Domain Consultant
description:
About The Role
As a MLEU Domain Expert, you will make an impact by supporting the pre-sales team in crafting compelling, market insight-led proposals and bid responses across Manufacturing, Automotive, Logistics and Energy & Utilities (MLEU), mapping client needs to Cognizant Moment digital engagement capabilities that communicate clear business value. Work model
At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Chennai, Bangalore, or Hyderabad. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
What You Must Have To Be Considered
• Bachelor's degree in engineering, preferably in computer science or IT; an MBA or relevant master's degree is preferred.

description:

We need individuals who can enable customer productivity and develop lasting relationships with our technology partners, making NVIDIA an integral part of end-user solutions. We are looking for someone always thinking about artificial intelligence, someone who can maintain constructive collaboration in a fast paced, rapidly evolving field, someone able to coordinate efforts between corporate marketing, industry business development and engineering. You will be working with the latest AI architecture coupled with the most advanced neural network models, changing the way people interact with technology.
What You Will Be Doing
• Architect end-to-end generative AI solutions with a focus on LLMs training , deployment and RAG workflows.
• Collaborate closely with customers to understand their language-related business challenges and design tailored solutions.
• Work closely with NVIDIA engineering teams to provide feedback and contribute to the evolution of generative AI software.

• Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and orchestration tools (e.g., Kubernetes) for scalable and efficient model deployment.

• Hands-on experience with NVIDIA GPU technologies, and GPU cluster management and ability to design and implement scalable and efficient workflows for LLM training and inference on GPU clusters

title: AI Manager
description:
AI Manager
Location
Gurugram (Udyog Vihar Phase III), on-site; occasional travel to project sites
Reports To - Head of IT
Experience - 7 to 10 years
Employment Type - Full-time, permanent
THE OPPORTUNITY
Most companies are still debating AI. We have decided to build it into how we engineer, bid, deliver and operate. WOG is looking for its first AI Manager to lead AI transformation and implementation across the company - deciding where AI goes to work, building it, and making sure it is adopted safely.
You will not be one voice in a large digital team. You will own the AI agenda end to end, with direct access to the CEO and leadership, and real engineering problems to solve - in water, wastewater and green energy.
ABOUT WOG
WOG Technologies is an IP-led engineering and technology company in water, wastewater and green energy, with 190+ projects delivered across 20+ countries and 350+ engineers. The group includes Bell Cooling Towers and the WOG Green Energy businesses - Green Coal, Carbon Loops, BESS, CBG and Carbon Credits. We are building a patent portfolio and a technology-first culture, and AI is central to that.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
Set the AI agenda
• Map how work flows across the business - proposals and bids, design and engineering, procurement, project delivery, plant operations and support functions - and find where AI saves the most time and money.
• Build and own a 12-month AI roadmap with a business case for every use case, and report the value delivered.
Get the data ready
• Organise the data AI depends on - document repositories, master data, and HR, finance and project records - so that AI answers are accurate and traceable.
• Set data ownership and quality standards with each function, starting with the data behind the first use cases.
Build and ship AI solutions
• Deploy enterprise AI tools - LLM assistants, document intelligence and workflow automation - and integrate them with our HRMS, ERP, Microsoft 365 and document systems.
• Design and deploy agentic AI: agents that carry out multi-step work across our systems, such as preparing tender responses, reconciling vendor quotes or compiling management reports, with people approving the key decisions.
• Automate high-effort work such as tender review, BOQ and estimation support, document control and management reporting.
• Explore AI for plant performance: predictive maintenance, process optimisation and remote monitoring.
Make AI safe to use
• Move WOG from restricted AI use to governed adoption: approved enterprise tools, a clear AI usage policy, and no company data in unapproved platforms.
• Configure data loss prevention (Microsoft Purview DLP) and sensitivity labels so AI tools see only what they should.
• Control what AI agents can access and do: least-privilege permissions, human approval for consequential actions, and full logging.
• Assess AI vendors for security, privacy and contractual risk; keep AI use compliant with the DPDP Act 2023 and IT Act 2000.
Bring people along
• Train employees and leaders to use AI well, and build a library of approved prompts, templates and agents.
• Work hand in hand with the IT team, which runs infrastructure and cyber security.
WHAT YOU BRING
Must have
• A bachelor's or master's degree in engineering, computer applications or a related discipline.
• 7 to 10 years in technology, digital transformation or engineering roles, including hands-on generative AI work since late 2022.
• AI work you can show us: at least two AI solutions taken to production in an organisation, with measurable results.
• Working knowledge of Python, APIs and low-code automation, and of data protection in Microsoft 365 (DLP, sensitivity labels, access controls).
• An AI certification or programme from a reputed institute (IIT, IISc, IIM, ISB or a global equivalent) or a recognised vendor (Microsoft, Google Cloud, AWS).
• Interest in engineering businesses, with understanding of the water and wastewater industry or a willingness to learn it quickly.
Good to have
• B.E./B.Tech in Computer Engineering or Computer Science.
• A cyber security certification - CISSP, CISM, CEH, CompTIA Security+ or Microsoft SC-401 / SC-300.
• Hands-on experience building agentic AI workflows (multi-step agents with tool access) in production.
• Postgraduate degree in AI, Machine Learning or Data Science.
• Experience in engineering, infrastructure, utilities, energy or manufacturing companies.
If you meet most of the must-haves and have shipped real AI work, apply. We hire for proven ability, not a perfect checklist.
WHY WOG
• Build it, don't maintain it: you are the first person in this role and shape how a whole company works.
• Direct line to leadership: your roadmap goes to the CEO, not through layers.
• Real-world impact and a broad canvas: water, wastewater and five green energy businesses.

title: Product Manager / Senior Product Manager - AI
description:
About the Role
Delhivery moves millions of shipments a day across one of the most complex physical networks: pickups, line-haul, sorting, last-mile, returns, and cross-border. Every one of those steps generates data, decisions, and money on the table. We believe the next decade of logistics will be won by whoever applies AI most intelligently to the physical world.
We are building a team of Product Managers who will reimagine logistics with an Agentic first approach. You won't be bolting a chatbot on a dashboard. You will own problems where a better model or a smarter agent changes unit economics, customer experience, or network reliability at national scale.
.What You’ll Do
• Find the right problems. Spend time in hubs, with riders, ops leaders, and merchants. Translate messy operational pain into opportunities for creating a seamless flow that scales.
• Own outcomes, not outputs. Define success metrics tied to cost per shipment, delivery success, NPS, or revenue, and be accountable for moving them.
• Ship AI products that real operators use. Design human-in-the-loop workflows, fallbacks, and feedback loops so models earn trust on the ground and keep improving after launch.
• Drive adoption across the org. Work with Operations, Sales, Finance, and Customer Experience to embed AI into how teams actually work.
• Partner deeply with data science and engineering. Shape problem formulation, data requirements, evaluation methodology, and model-versus-rules trade-offs. Understand precision/recall, drift, latency, and cost well enough to challenge and be challenged.
• Run rigorous experimentation. A/B tests, shadow deployments, and phased rollouts across geographies and hubs, with clear go/no-go criteria.
• Stay at the frontier. Evaluate new LLM, agentic, and vision capabilities, and decide pragmatically what to build, buy, or fine-tune.
The kind of problems you could own
• Network intelligence: demand forecasting, capacity planning, dynamic routing, and ETA prediction across the network
• Last-mile optimization: address intelligence and geocoding, delivery-attempt prediction, route and slot optimization, rider productivity
• Computer vision on the ground: shipment damage detection, automated weighing and dimensioning, sort-center throughput, proof-of-delivery verification
• Generative AI and agents: autonomous customer support, ops copilots for hub managers, document and invoice automation, internal knowledge assistants
• Risk and trust: fraud, RTO (return-to-origin) prediction, NDR resolution, and merchant risk scoring
• Pricing and commercial intelligence: dynamic pricing, serviceability, and yield optimization
You will be matched to problem statements based on impact, your strengths, and the stage of each problem. Expect to work across more than one.
What We’re Looking For
Experience
• 2–5 years in product management, ideally with at least 1–2 years shipping ML or AI-driven products (or a strong data science, ML engineering, or analytics background that you have transitioned into product)
• A track record of taking a product from ambiguous problem to measurable business impact
• Strong academic grounding; engineering degree from a top-tier institution preferred, MBA a plus but not required
Skills
• Working fluency in ML concepts: model evaluation, training data quality, feedback loops, and the practical differences between classical ML, deep learning, and LLM-based systems
• Hands-on comfort with data: SQL is a must, Python or notebooks a plus. You pull your own numbers.
• Experience with, or sharp point of view on, GenAI product design: prompt and eval design, RAG, agents, guardrails, and cost/latency trade-offs
• Excellent structured thinking and the ability to communicate with engineers, data scientists, and frontline ops leaders equally well
• Bias to action, ownership, and comfort operating in complex, high-volume, real-world environments
Pedigree signals we value
• Prior experience at product-led or AI-forward companies (marketplaces, e-commerce, mobility, fintech, SaaS, or AI-native startups)
• Evidence of impact: shipped models or AI features with quantifiable results, side projects, or published work
• Curiosity about the physical world: supply chains, operations, and hardware-meets-software problems

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
About KrisAtWork
Kris@Work is the new generation AI-native Go-To-Market platform. It runs a B2B company's entire revenue engine, from finding the right accounts to closing and growing them. Revenue teams today juggle 25+ disconnected tools. Kris@Work replaces them with a single system, powered by its proprietary Kris Tell Intelligence™ layer and a multi-agent architecture that thinks, decides, and acts across the revenue cycle.
About the Role
We are looking for a AI-native Product Manager who blends product thinking, data science rigor, and comes with hands-on AI fluency. This role owns the end-to-end product lifecycle for AI-driven capabilities, ranging from predictive models to generative experiences, translating complex data & ML systems into scalable, customer-impacting products.
The ideal candidate has prior experience in data science or ML, deeply understands model behavior, trade-offs, and evaluation, and can partner seamlessly with engineering, ML, and business stakeholders to ship intelligent, impactful, reliable & explainable AI products.
What You’ll Do
Product Strategy & AI Vision
• Define & own the AI product vision and roadmap, aligned with business outcomes and measurable customer value
• Identify high-leverage prediction and generation opportunities across user workflows
• Translate ambiguous business problems into clear AI-powered product hypotheses
• Prioritize features using data, expected lift, confidence intervals & ROI modeling
Predictive AI Ownership
• Lead products powered by classification, regression, ranking, forecasting & anomaly detection models
• Define prediction targets, labels, features, and success criteria in collaboration with AI/ ML engineering teams
• Drive decisions around model refresh cadence, retraining triggers & drift detection
Generative AI & LLM-Driven Experiences
• Own GenAI use-cases including summarization, recommendations, copilots, content generation & reasoning workflows
• Design prompt strategies, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool-calling & memory architectures
• Balance determinism, creativity, latency & cost across GenAI experiences
• Define evaluation frameworks for GenAI quality (faithfulness, relevance, completeness, toxicity, hallucinations)
Data-Driven Product Execution
• Write clear, technical PRDs that include data inputs & outputs, model assumptions & constraints, evaluation metrics & guardrails, failure modes & fallback strategies
• Partner deeply with ML engineers to review feature pipelines, model choices & offline vs online evaluation results
• Make informed trade-offs between rules, heuristics, classical ML & LLMs
Experimentation & Measurement
• Design and own A/B tests, holdouts & phased rollouts for AI features
• Measure incremental impact, not just accuracy (conversion lift, time saved, win-rate, retention)
• Build feedback loops to improve models using human-in-the-loop signals
• Define north-star & secondary metrics for AI success
Cross-Functional Leadership
• Act as the product glue between ML, engineering, design, sales, customer success & leadership
• Translate technical AI concepts into clear business narratives for executives
• Partner with go-to-market teams on AI positioning, trust messaging & explainability
• Influence without authority, and set direction through clarity & data
AI Ethics, Trust & Reliability
• Ensure responsible AI practices around bias detection & mitigation, explainability & transparency as well as privacy, data governance & compliance
• Define guardrails, confidence indicators, and override mechanisms for AI outputs
• Proactively identify edge cases and failure scenarios before customers do
Who You Are & What Makes You Qualified
• 4+ years of Product Management experience, with significant ownership of data and/or AI-powered products
• Proven track record shipping predictive models and/or GenAI products to production
• Strong understanding of supervised & unsupervised ML, feature engineering & data pipelines, model evaluation & experimentation
• Practical experience with LLMs (OpenAI/ Anthropic), RAG, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering & evaluation
• Comfortable querying data (SQL) & reading Python notebooks
• Ability to reason about model performance, trade-offs & limitations
• Deep intuition for user workflows & decision-making under uncertainty
• Ability to connect model output to user action & business outcome
• Strong prioritization skills grounded in data, not intuition alone
• Experience building 0→1 AI products or scaling AI features across large user bases
• Experience with B2B SaaS, sales tech, CRM, or revenue intelligence platforms is preferred
• Prior hands-on experience as a Data Scientist, ML Engineer, or Applied Scientist is preferred
• Exposure to real-time systems, streaming data, or low-latency inference
• Experience working with enterprise customers and regulated data
• Familiarity with AI infra tools (feature stores, model registries, monitoring)
• Excellent communication, stakeholder management & executive-level presentation & delivery skills
• Bachelor's degree in a technical, engineering, AI or related discipline; advanced degree is preferred

title: Product Manager - AI
description:

title: Product Manager, AI
description:
Cin7 is a fast-growing global software company that provides solutions for modern-day product sellers. We help these sellers keep track of their inventory at scale, and help them sell their products across multiple sales channels around the world.
Cin7 is expanding very quickly with a mission to become the leading Inventory Management Software brand in the world, and we are looking for a motivated and driven individual to join the team.
Cin7 India is proud of our culture and has been officially recognised with Great Place to Work® Certification™.
How You'll Make An Impact
As a Product Manager with AI experience, you are the link between our users and our engineering team. You will work with users to understand what they need, and you will have the technical skills to work with engineers to deliver it. A key part of the role is finding where AI can save our customers time and effort in inventory management, and turning those opportunities into features that enterprise users love and trust.
You will explore and shape product ideas by interviewing customers, studying competitors, and testing new technology, including AI models, tools, and open source options. There are many good ideas, but only some can be built. You will work with UX, engineering, and leadership to choose the ones that matter most, and to decide where AI is the right answer and where a simpler solution works better.
What You'll Do
• Turn business goals into clear software requirements. 
• Find and define AI use cases for Core, such as forecasting, data entry, search, and automation of routine tasks, and write the requirements for each. 
• Rank features based on market research, customer need, and company strategy. 
• Manage project scope by making trade-offs between time and cost, and between security and speed. 
• Set success measures for AI features, such as accuracy, time saved, and user adoption, and track them after launch. 
• Work with engineers to decide how to build, test, and monitor AI features, including how we handle wrong or unexpected results. 
• Work with Security, Legal, and Engineering to handle customer data responsibly in AI features, including privacy, data use, and cost of running the models. 
• Rank feature requests from the development teams. 
• Set the product vision and work closely with the technical team to define specifications. 
• Make sure the product meets business goals and user needs. 
• Track progress against plan and fix variances as soon as they appear. 
• Make trade-offs between features, schedule, and cost, based on business goals, company policies, software architecture, and team capacity. 
What You'll Bring
• Proven work experience in product management or as an associate product manager, preferably in B2B SaaS, with inventory management, supply chain, or ecommerce domain experience a plus. 
• Hands-on experience shipping at least one product or feature that uses AI or machine learning, including large language models. 
• Working understanding of how AI features are built and tested, such as prompts, model selection, evaluation, accuracy, and data quality. You do not need to write code. 
• Awareness of AI risks, including incorrect answers, bias, privacy, and cost, and how to reduce them. 
• Proven track record of managing a successful product through its full lifecycle. 
• Proven ability to develop product and marketing strategies and present recommendations to executive management. 
• Structured approach and experience with agile methods. 
• History of working with development teams to get results. 
• Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to roll up your sleeves. 
• Skilled at working with cross-functional teams in a matrix organization. 
• Enthusiasm for new technology and a practical view of what it can and cannot do. 
• Ability to be productive in a globally distributed team through self-discipline and self-motivation. 
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
Why Work for Us?
• We are a fast growing business going through a huge amount of growth. 
• You’ll have the opportunity to work on products that are used by our global customer-base and at the same time you’ll be growing your career and developing new skills.
• Work From Anywhere for 30 days in a six month period
• Celebrate your birthday with a paid day off
• A Global Cin7 Day celebrated companywide, providing you a dedicated holiday to focus on your own wellbeing.
• Recruitment referral bonus
• Work for a Great Place to Work®
Why CIN7?
CIN7 is a leader in one of the most exciting software verticals right now, and we're growing exponentially. We're looking to add people to our team who are passionate about working with a fast growth tech company.
At CIN7, we make great products available to everyone. Every month, millions of sales orders flow through our platform reducing the cost, effort and time for product sellers so they can quickly get products to customers and build their brands without worrying about their operations. We pride ourselves on providing Inventory Management and Supply Chain software to help medium-large product businesses thrive in a highly competitive, digital world.  We value diversity at Cin7, and bring people into the heart of everything we do.
