We foster an open, progressive company culture with state-of-the-art technology and flat hierarchies. At Enterprise Bot, you'll experience a unique blend of passion, ambition, challenge, and fun.
Tasks
Enterprise Bot builds agentic AI for voice, chat, email and messaging, and sells it to large enterprises in deals with long cycles, multiple stakeholders, procurement scrutiny and real compliance requirements.
Our growth constraint is not awareness. It is qualified, sales-ready pipeline in the accounts we actually want. This role owns that pipeline. You will design, run and optimise the programmes that generate and convert demand across Europe, and you will be measured on pipeline and revenue contribution rather than on lead volume.
What you'll own:
Pipeline generation
• Own the demand generation strategy and quarterly pipeline targets by region and segment
• Design and run integrated campaigns across paid search, paid social, content syndication, SEO, email and webinars
• Build and run account-based marketing programmes against a defined target account list, in tight coordination with sales
• Develop the outbound support layer: sequences, content and intent-based targeting that make SDR and AE outreach land
Funnel ownership and conversion
• Own the funnel end to end, from traffic and conversion through MQL, SQL, opportunity and closed-won, and diagnose where it leaks
• Build and maintain lead scoring, routing and nurture flows so that sales receives genuinely qualified handoffs
• Run structured experimentation on landing pages, offers, messaging and channel mix
• Improve conversion rates on existing traffic before spending to increase it
Marketing operations and measurement
• Own the marketing automation and CRM stack (HubSpot), including workflows, lifecycle stages, data hygiene and attribution
• Build reporting that connects spend to pipeline to revenue, and report it honestly to leadership
• Manage the demand generation budget with clear accountability for cost per opportunity and pipeline ROI
Website ownership
• You own the website as a platform and as a conversion asset. Product Marketing owns the messaging on
• core product and solution pages, and Content owns localisation into market languages.
• Own the website platform and CMS, including the publishing workflow, page templates, governance and release process
• Own technical SEO and site performance, including site structure, page speed, indexation, structured data and Core Web Vitals
• Own site analytics and tracking, including tag management, event tracking, consent management and the attribution model
• Build and optimise landing pages and campaign pages, and run continuous conversion rate optimisation across the site
• Implement the information architecture and site narrative proposed by Product Marketing, and challenge it where it conflicts with conversion or search performance
• Coordinate with Content on the rollout and technical implementation of localised pages, including hreflang and market-level site structure
• Manage external web development or agency resource where required
Programmes and partners
• Run the webinar and event programme, including field and industry events across Europe and India
• Build co-marketing programmes with integrators, BPOs and technology partners
• Work with Product Marketing so that campaign messaging reflects current positioning rather than drifting from it
• Support product and platform launches with the demand side of the launch plan
Requirements
• 5+ years in demand generation, growth or performance marketing within B2B technology, SaaS or enterprise software
• Track record generating pipeline for enterprise deals with long, complex sales cycles, rather than SMB or self-serve motions
• Hands-on expertise with marketing automation and CRM, ideally HubSpot. You build the workflows yourself
• Hands-on website ownership experience, including working directly in a CMS, and practical technical SEO capability rather than oversight of someone else doing it
• Working knowledge of web analytics and tag management implementation, including event tracking and consent requirements under GDPR
• Strong analytical capability across funnel diagnostics, attribution, and cohort and channel analysis
• Demonstrated ABM experience against named enterprise accounts
• Paid media management experience with real budget accountability
• Strong written English
• Comfort operating with European working hours for part of the day
Strongly preferred
• Experience marketing to European enterprise buyers, particularly in financial services or insurance
• Background in conversational AI, CCaaS, contact centre or enterprise automation categories
• Experience running multilingual campaigns across European markets, and managing a multilingual website structure
• SQL or advanced analytics capability
• Experience in a company scaling from founder-led sales toward a repeatable marketing engine
How we’ll know you are the right fit
• You talk in pipeline and revenue, not impressions and MQLs
• You can point to specific programmes you built and the pipeline they produced
• You have killed a channel that was not working, and can explain how you knew
First 90 days
• Days 1 to 30: Full funnel audit complete. Baseline metrics established by channel and region. Website technical SEO and tracking audit complete, with gaps identified.
• Days 31 to 60: Target account list agreed with sales. First ABM programme live. The two or three highest-potential channels prioritised and resourced.
• Days 61 to 90: Repeatable campaign cadence running. Pipeline reporting live and trusted by sales leadership. A clear view of cost per opportunity by channel.
Benefits
• Shape a function from the ground up – Build Enterprise Bot's first Product Marketing function and have a direct impact on product strategy, positioning and go-to-market.
• Work with cutting-edge AI – Help define the market narrative for an enterprise-grade agentic AI platform used by leading financial services, insurance and public sector organisations across Europe.
• Global exposure – Collaborate daily with Product, Engineering and commercial teams across Switzerland, Spain, Poland, the UK and other European markets.
• High ownership, low bureaucracy – Take ownership of launches, competitive strategy and messaging, with the autonomy to influence business decisions and work directly with senior leadership.
• Competitive salary and performance-based incentives – We offer a competitive compensation package aligned to experience and impact.
This is a unique opportunity to build a Growth Marketing function from the ground up and influence how Enterprise Bot competes and grows across Europe. If that excites you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager: AI & Product-Led Growth (PLG)
description:
About CloudNuroHelp shape the future of AI adoption.
CloudNuro is a Chicago-based technology company and a proud winner of the 2025 Chicago Innovation Award, recognized for its innovative approach to technology governance and financial accountability.
We are on a mission to make AI adoption accessible, measurable, and responsible for organizations of all sizes.
Through AgentNuro, our AI Adoption Management platform, we help companies discover AI tools and agents, manage Shadow AI, track AI usage and token consumption, optimize AI costs, and govern AI adoption.
We are building the next phase of our growth around Product-Led Growth (PLG), enabling startups, small businesses, and growing teams to discover, try, adopt, and realize value from AI with minimal friction.
This is an opportunity to join an award-winning, innovation-driven company and play a defining role in how we bring our AI platform to market.
The RoleWe are looking for a hands-on Senior Product Marketing Manager who combines strategic thinking, creativity, and strong execution skills.
You will be instrumental in building and scaling AgentNuro's product-led growth strategy, from creating compelling positioning and messaging to driving organic discovery, product adoption, user engagement, and conversion.
We need someone who understands how to market technology to startups and smaller organizations, where customers expect immediate value, simple experiences, and minimal purchasing friction.
You should be equally comfortable:
• Developing differentiated product positioning, messaging, and category narratives.
• Building and executing PLG go-to-market strategies.
• Creating website content, campaigns, product videos, presentations, and marketing collateral.
• Using AI tools extensively and coordinating a small internal or external team.
This is a role for a builder and doer, not someone who only develops strategy and delegates execution.
What You Will OwnProduct Positioning & MessagingDevelop differentiated positioning and messaging for AgentNuro and our AI Adoption Management solutions.
• Translate AI discovery, Shadow AI, AI governance, token management, AI cost attribution, and optimization into simple customer benefits.
• Create messaging around immediate value, ease of adoption, and measurable business outcomes.
• Refine positioning based on user feedback, competitor analysis, product insights, and market trends.
Category & Market DevelopmentHelp CloudNuro establish AI Adoption Management as an important and emerging technology category.
• Develop narratives around AI adoption, Shadow AI, AI agents, AI governance, AI cost management, and TokenOps.
• Identify emerging AI trends, customer challenges, and opportunities to differentiate AgentNuro.
• Turn insights into thought leadership, educational content, campaigns, and market awareness.
Go-to-Market & Product LaunchesOwn product marketing for new capabilities and releases, with a strong emphasis on PLG.
• Develop ICPs, personas, value propositions, and product messaging.
• Build PLG campaigns focused on acquisition, self-service discovery, onboarding, activation, engagement, and conversion.
• Develop launch plans, website messaging, landing pages, educational content, demo narratives, and promotional campaigns.
• Run go-to-market experiments to improve the journey from awareness to adoption and paid conversion.
• Work closely with Product Management to align marketing with product experience and customer needs.
Product & Customer EnablementCreate content and experiences that help users understand AgentNuro and get started with minimal friction.
• Product walkthroughs, explainer videos, solution briefs, use cases, FAQs, and getting-started content.
• Product demos, value propositions, and conversion-focused messaging.
• Customer education, self-service onboarding, and partner enablement.
Competitive IntelligenceDevelop a systematic competitive intelligence program across AI Adoption Management, AI governance, AI cost management, and emerging AI platforms.
• Monitor competitor positioning, messaging, capabilities, pricing, launches, and customer acquisition strategies.
• Study competitor PLG models, onboarding, self-service journeys, and conversion approaches.
• Translate research into actionable recommendations for Product, Marketing, and leadership.
Content & Thought LeadershipCreate high-quality content that establishes CloudNuro and AgentNuro as credible voices in the AI ecosystem.
• Product blogs, educational guides, solution briefs, thought leadership, and industry content.
• LinkedIn content, growth campaigns, customer stories, webinars, and promotional material.
• Product videos, demo scripts, tutorials, presentations, and other creative assets.
You should be a strong writer and storyteller who can take an idea from concept to finished content without depending on a large content team.
Website, SEO & AI Search VisibilityMake AgentNuro discoverable when users search for solutions to their AI adoption challenges.
• Develop SEO-optimized website content, landing pages, solution pages, and educational resources.
• Improve visibility across traditional search and AI answer engines, including ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity.
• Use keyword research, search behavior, competitor analysis, AI visibility testing, and conversion insights to improve performance.
Customer & Market IntelligenceDevelop a strong understanding of startups, small businesses, AI developers, and growing teams.
• Understand customer pain points, buying motivations, adoption barriers, and expectations.
• Analyze behavior across the PLG funnel.
• Translate customer and market insights into improvements across positioning, content, product experience, and growth strategy.
AI-Native Way of WorkingAI proficiency is a core requirement for this role, not a nice-to-have.
We expect our Senior Product Marketing Manager to actively leverage modern AI tools to improve productivity, accelerate execution, and enhance the quality of deliverables.
You should be proficient in using AI for:
• Research: Market intelligence, competitive analysis, personas, and trends.
• Content & Messaging: Positioning, writing, editing, SEO, AI-search optimization, and campaigns.
• Creative & Multimedia: Presentations, product videos, visual content, and collateral.
• Analytics & Automation: Growth analysis, PLG funnel insights, workflow automation, and marketing productivity.
Experience with tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, or similar platforms is expected.
We are particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate how they have used AI to work faster and more effectively while applying appropriate validation, expertise, and human judgment.
What We Are Looking ForYou likely have:
• 5+ years of experience in technology product marketing, preferably in AI or related emerging technologies.
• Hands-on experience in Product-Led Growth (PLG), digital product marketing, or self-service customer acquisition.
• Experience marketing products to startups, small businesses, and growing technology teams.
• Strong product positioning, messaging, technical writing, presentation, and storytelling skills.
• Experience with go-to-market strategies, product launches, organic growth campaigns, and competitive intelligence.
• Understanding of PLG metrics such as acquisition, activation, engagement, conversion, and retention.
• Demonstrated proficiency with generative AI tools and their practical application to marketing workflows.
• Strong individual execution skills and the ability to coordinate a small team or external resources in a fast-moving startup environment.
The Type of Person Who Will Succeed HereYou are a builder, a creator, and a doer.
You enjoy taking an idea from a blank page and turning it into something that drives real customer engagement.
You understand that successful PLG is about making a product easy to discover, easy to understand, easy to try, and valuable enough for customers to adopt and pay for.
You do not need a large team to make progress. You know how to prioritize, execute independently, and leverage a small team, external resources, and AI tools to multiply your impact.
You are intellectually curious, passionate about emerging AI technologies, and continuously experiment with new tools and marketing approaches.
Most importantly, you measure success by business impact, product adoption, customer acquisition, and growth, not simply the number of assets produced.
What Success Looks LikeWithin your first 6 to 12 months, you will help CloudNuro:
• Establish differentiated positioning for AgentNuro in the AI Adoption Management market.
• Build a repeatable, scalable product marketing and PLG go-to-market motion.
• Improve product discovery, website traffic, self-service onboarding, activation, and conversion.
• Develop a strong library of product marketing assets, educational content, and customer stories.
• Increase AgentNuro's visibility across traditional search, AI search, and industry discussions.
• Establish a competitive intelligence program and contribute directly to user acquisition, adoption, and revenue growth.
Why CloudNuroAI is transforming how the world works. We are building the platform that helps organizations adopt it with confidence.
At CloudNuro, you won't just be marketing another technology product. You will have an opportunity to shape an emerging AI category, influence product strategy, experiment with modern growth approaches, and help build a globally recognized AI platform.
You will work directly with company leadership, Product, and Marketing, with the freedom to bring ideas to life and see their impact.
If you are passionate about AI, excited by product-led growth, and thrive in an environment that values ownership, creativity, speed, and execution, we'd love to hear from you.
Join CloudNuro. Help make intelligent AI adoption accessible to everyone.

title: Content Marketing Manager (Bangalore/Remote)
description:
About StackGen
StackGen is building the autonomous operations factory - a platform purpose-built for the teams responsible for keeping modern infrastructure reliable and fast. We serve engineering organisations across multiple high-growth segments including infrastructure and platform engineering, AI SRE, and managed open source observability.
Our products — Aiden for Infrastructure, Aiden for SRE, and Aiden for Observability, and Aiden for DevOps and now Shipyard by StackGen — give platform engineers, SREs, DevOps engineers, and their leaders the autonomous capabilities they need to eliminate toil, reduce mean time to resolution, and scale confidently. We are growing fast, expanding our market presence and product portfolio, and building the team that will take us to the next stage.
The Role
Content is how StackGen reaches the engineers, SREs, platform teams, and technical leaders who need what we build. It's how they discover us, how they form a view of what we do, and how they decide we're worth a closer look. As Content Marketing Manager, you own that content engine — from creation through to distribution — across every channel where our potential customers learn, search, and form opinions.
Your job has two halves, and both matter equally. The first is creating content that resonates: posts, articles, scripts, narratives, and short-form pieces that land with technical audiences because they sound like they were written by someone who actually understands the world they're written for. The second is making sure that content travels — reaching the right people, in the right channels, at the velocity a fast-moving company needs.
To do that at the scale we need, this role owns the AI-powered workflow systems that turn a single piece of source material into the right content for every channel where it should appear. Building, running, and evolving those workflows is a core part of the job, not an add-on.
You'll work daily with our Product Marketing function, our Technical Marketing Engineers, our executive team, and our engineering and product leadership across all three of our market segments.
What You'll Own
Content Creation
You're responsible for the content that StackGen puts into the market — originating it, building on the work happening across the rest of the company, and orchestrating the workflows that make it all possible at the volume we need:
• Originating content — net new content that begins with this role rather than coming from a product launch or a technical deep-dive. This includes broader market-shift pieces where StackGen has a perspective worth sharing (the move toward agentic operations is one current example), and major project-led work. Our State of Reliability 2026 survey — analysing more than 50,000 incidents — is the kind of project this role originates and owns end-to-end
• Channel-native day-to-day content — the LinkedIn posts, newsletter content, social threads, scripts, and short-form video that the constant flow of StackGen presence requires
• Content built on technical and positioning work — taking the deep technical material produced by our Technical Marketing Engineers and the positioning developed by our Product Marketing function and turning it into content that lands across channels and personas
• Executive thought leadership — working with our CEO, CPO, engineering leadership, and other senior voices to turn their expertise into a consistent, credible external presence
• Editorial standards — establishing and maintaining the voice, tone, and quality bar for everything we publish under the StackGen brand
Distribution Across Channels
You make sure StackGen content reaches the people it's built for, wherever they spend time:
• Social platforms — LinkedIn as the primary surface for both company and individual presence, plus other networks where DevOps and SRE practitioners and leaders gather
• Engineering communities — Discords, Slacks, Reddit, Hacker News, CNCF forums, and other practitioner spaces, with content that earns credibility rather than imposing on it
• Video platforms — YouTube and other video channels where our audience learns and evaluates
• Owned channels — the StackGen website, email and newsletter programmes, and our resource and video library, ensuring content lives somewhere our audience can return to
• Earned media and guest contributions — supporting placements in publications and external blogs that our buyers actually read, and coordinating opportunities for StackGen team members to contribute
• Search and AI discovery — working with the broader marketing team to ensure content is structured for SEO and AEO (AI Engine Optimisation), so it surfaces in both traditional search and AI-assisted discovery
AI-Powered Workflow Systems
Operating across this many channels at the velocity we need is only possible with serious AI leverage. You'll own the workflow systems that make it work:
• Building and evolving AI-assisted content workflows that turn source material into channel-appropriate content at scale, with human-in-the-loop quality control
• Designing the systems and skill-based prompts that enable consistent voice and quality across formats and channels
• Continuously improving the workflow stack as the team grows and as AI tooling evolves
• Acting as the in-house standard-setter for what good AI-augmented content production looks like — so that AI is a structural advantage, not a productivity experiment
Amplification of StackGen's People
StackGen's engineers, product team, and leaders are doing work worth talking about. You make sure that work travels:
• Coaching and supporting team members on building consistent external voices, particularly on LinkedIn
• Helping engineering and product translate what they're building into stories that resonate externally
• Identifying and building relationships with credible external voices in the DevOps, SRE, and cloud-native space — collaborating on content, joint posts, podcast appearances, and community presence
Contributing Across the Marketing System
Your content and distribution work feeds into and supports the broader marketing function:
• Demand generation — supplying the content that powers paid, outbound, and lifecycle programmes; learning back from performance data to inform what to create next
• Events — producing pre-event, at-event, and post-event content that extends the reach of our field activity
• Analytics — tracking content performance across channels and using that data to direct effort
What We're Looking For
• Familiarity with the DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering world — enough to know the audiences, the conversations, and what credibility looks like in these communities. You don't need to have been an engineer; we have Technical Marketing Engineers who provide deep technical expertise. What we need from you is ecosystem fluency
• A strong content instinct — you can tell what will resonate with a technical audience and what won't, and you can produce content that lands rather than content that just exists
• Multi-channel distribution craft — you understand how content behaves differently on LinkedIn vs. in a community vs. on a blog vs. in an email, and you can make the same source material work across all of them
• Genuine AI fluency at the workflow level — you build and operate AI-assisted systems, not just use AI tools occasionally. You're comfortable owning a workflow stack that produces content across many formats and channels at velocity
• Hands-on fluency across the tools modern content marketing runs on — for creation, distribution, measurement, and analysis. Our current stack includes HubSpot, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Canva on the operational side, and Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, AirOps, and others on the AI side. We expect comfort across this kind of toolset and active engagement in evolving it as the space changes
• A reach orientation — you think about where the right people are, what they pay attention to, and what StackGen needs to do to show up there credibly and consistently
• A bias toward data — you track what's landing, you adjust based on signal, and you make the case for content investment with evidence
• Comfort working at high velocity across many channels and personas, from individual contributors (platform engineers, SREs, DevOps engineers) up to senior technical leaders (VPs of Engineering, CTOs)
A Note on Background
There's no single path that leads here. Backgrounds in content marketing at a DevOps or infrastructure tooling company, technical content writing, DevRel, or technical community management are all directly relevant. We care about ecosystem fluency, content craft, and AI-native operating style more than any particular job title or year count.

description:

title: Growth Marketing Manager
description:
About Skit.ai
Skit.ai is an AI-native collections company. We run collections for lenders, banks, credit unions, fintechs, and debt buyers across the US and Canada. We combine our own software with human collectors, so clients get recovery outcomes rather than a tool they have to staff and run themselves. We are not a voice bot vendor. We are not a generic SaaS product. We are the team that recovers the money.
Job Title: Growth Marketing Manager: Lead Generation and Awareness
Location: Bengaluru, India. (100% WFO)
Shift: 12:00 PM to 9:00 PM IST. This covers the UK business day and the start of the US East Coast morning.
The role
You own two things: filling the pipeline, and making sure the right people in US and Canadian receivables know who we are before we ever call them.
Roughly How The Week Splits
• 50% lead generation. Building and running the outbound and inbound motion that produces qualified meetings.
• 35% awareness. Content, events, industry presence, search, and answer engines. Getting Skit.ai into the conversation.
• 15% product marketing. Sharpening how we describe what we do, and arming Sales with the material that closes.
This is a builder role, not a maintainer role. The motion is not fully built yet. You will be the one building it.
What You Will Own
Lead generation
• Build and maintain the ICP and target account lists for US and Canadian lenders, banks, credit unions, fintechs, debt buyers, and collection agencies.
• Run account research and enrichment in Apollo, Clay, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator. Find the real buyer, not the closest job title.
• Write and run outbound sequences across email and LinkedIn. Test messaging, measure reply quality, kill what does not work.
• Own inbound capture and routing in HubSpot. Forms, lead scoring, follow-up speed, handoff to Sales.
• Report pipeline weekly. Meetings booked, meetings held, pipeline sourced, cost per qualified meeting, and where each number is stuck.
Awareness
• Run the content calendar. Blogs, teardowns, benchmark pieces, customer stories, short reports. Publish on a cadence, not in bursts.
• Own SEO and AEO. Rank for the queries buyers search, and get Skit.ai cited when they ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews about collections vendors. Track which answers name us and which do not.
• Run the industry presence calendar. RMAI, ACA International, insideARM, credit union and fintech events, podcasts, and association newsletters. Decide what we sponsor, what we attend, and what we skip.
• Turn every event into pipeline. Pre-event target lists, on-site meeting booking, post-event follow-up. No booth with no plan.
• Track share of voice against the competitive set and report it monthly.
Product marketing
• Keep the positioning tight and current. What Skit.ai is, who it is for, why it wins.
• Build and maintain the competitive battlecards. Refresh them when competitors change their pitch.
• Write the sales collateral that actually gets used. One-pagers, ROI narratives, case studies, objection handling.
• Sit in on customer calls. Bring the language buyers use back into our copy.
Your First 90 Days
• Days 1 to 30. Learn the collections market and the buyer. Sit in on sales calls. Audit the current funnel end to end and tell us where it leaks. Ship the first competitive teardown refresh.
• Days 31 to 60. Ship a rebuilt target account list with clear tiers. Launch two outbound sequences and one content play. Publish an SEO and AEO baseline with a plan to close the gaps.
• Days 61 to 90. A repeatable weekly motion producing qualified meetings, with numbers you can defend. A content calendar running on schedule. Battlecards live and in use by Sales.
Required
What we are looking for:
• 3 to 6 years in B2B demand generation, growth marketing, or a sales development role with real marketing ownership. US or European market experience.
• You have personally built target lists and written outbound that got replies. This is not a role where you brief an agency.
• Working command of a CRM and a sales engagement stack. HubSpot, Apollo, Clay, Sales Navigator, or close equivalents.
• Practical SEO knowledge. Keyword research, content briefs, on-page structure, and the tools to measure it.
• You write clean. Short sentences, specific claims, no filler.
• Comfortable with the 12 PM to 9 PM IST shift and with US and Canadian business norms.
Strong Advantage
• Experience selling into financial services, lending, collections, or fintech.
• You have run AEO deliberately, not just heard the term. You can show what you changed and what it moved.
• Experience marketing a service or outcome, not only a software license.
• Event marketing experience where you owned the pipeline number, not the booth.
How You Work
• You rank and choose under incomplete information, then defend the call.
• You measure what you ship and say plainly when it did not work.
• You go find the answer instead of waiting for a brief.
What We Offer
• Ownership of an entire funnel in a category that is being redrawn right now.
• Direct access to the founders and to customers. Short path from idea to shipped.
• Competitive salary with a performance component tied to pipeline.
• Health insurance and standard India benefits.

What We're Looking For
We're looking for someone who combines strong marketing expertise with curiosity, technology, and ownership.
The ideal candidate will have:

AI & Automation Mindset
We're not looking for marketers who simply use AI tools—we're looking for marketers who know how to combine deep marketing expertise with AI to produce better outcomes.
You'll stand out if you:
• Use AI to improve the speed, quality, and effectiveness of your work.
• Build automations that reduce manual effort and improve consistency.
• Apply critical thinking and marketing expertise to validate AI-generated outputs.
• Continuously explore new AI tools, workflows, and marketing technologies.
• Stay updated with evolving industry trends and best practices.
• Proactively identify better ways of working and contribute to improving internal processes.
Why Join The Smarketers?

• Be part of a collaborative, high-performance agency where ownership, innovation, and continuous learning are valued.
• Work alongside specialists across strategy, RevOps, Content, SEO, Paid Media, Design, Development, and Marketing Technology.
• Get the opportunity to experiment with AI, automation, and modern marketing technologies to shape the future of B2B marketing.
• Accelerate your professional growth through challenging work, meaningful client exposure, and continuous upskilling.
Our Ideal Team Member
We value people who:
• Think strategically and execute with excellence.
• Take ownership and lead with accountability.
• Communicate confidently with clients and internal teams.
• Have a strong Inbound Marketing mindset with a passion for generating measurable business outcomes.
• Understand how ABM complements inbound strategies to accelerate enterprise growth.

title: Marketing AI Specialist, Associate(Looking for Marketing background with Agentic AI experience)
description:
Department: Marketing

Description
The Marketing Agentic Content Engineer will build and continuously improve the AI-powered agents and workflows that move content from generation through review, translation, and publishing — connecting tools such as Claude, Canva, ContentHub, Sitecore, ClickUp, and similar systems. This role owns both ends of that pipeline: the technical integrations that move content through the system, and the prompt engineering and quality practices that shape what the AI actually produces, including the brand, messaging, legal, and compliance guardrails required across Infor's specialized industry verticals (e.g., Food & Beverage, Manufacturing & Distribution). This role will partner closely with marketing content owners, creative teams, marketing operations, and process owners to ensure what gets built holds up in real production use and reflects brand and messaging guidelines, positioning, workflow requirements, approved images, and other stakeholder requirements.
This role is ideal for professionals with hands-on experience building automated or agentic workflows with LLM platforms, who also know how to improve what those platforms produce — not just move it through a pipeline faster. Candidates should be able to take process direction from a review team and turn it into a working technical solution, connect their build work to broader process and strategic goals, and treat output quality as a core part of the job rather than a downstream concern. This is an individual contributor role focused on hands-on build, workflow design, and AI output quality.
A Typical Day In The Life Includes
•  Build and maintain agentic workflows moving content from AI generation into staging and publishing systems.
•  Build and maintain prompt libraries and testing practices that improve AI output quality, reduce hallucinations, and strengthen brand-voice consistency.
•  Define and apply content governance guardrails — brand, messaging, legal, and compliance — particularly for Infor's specialized industry verticals, in partnership with solution marketers.
•  Partner with the content process review team to translate process findings and recommendations into working agentic workflows.
•  Maintain and improve integrations between systems such as Claude, Canva, ContentHub, Sitecore, ClickUp, or other similar tools.
•  Set up and manage translation workflows so content can be routed and published across markets.
•  Troubleshoot breakdowns in the content pipeline and fix root causes, not just symptoms — whether the issue is a broken integration or a weak prompt.
•  Work with marketing content owners to understand content needs and build workflows that match real team workflows.
•  Document workflows so marketing operations can run and troubleshoot them without engineering support.
•  Flag scaling risks or technical debt before they block the broader content program.
•  Support the ongoing build-out of the AI content program as it scales across additional teams and use cases.
•  Identify where a workflow or process fix could apply beyond its original use case, and raise it as a broader opportunity to the content process review team or program leadership.
Basic Qualifications
•  Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Marketing, or related discipline, or equivalent hands-on experience.
•  2-3 years building automated or agentic workflows using Claude or comparable LLM platforms, including API/tool use, not just chat-based prompting.
•  Hands-on prompt engineering experience: building and testing prompts, measuring content quality, and reducing errors such as hallucinations or tone drift.
•  Marketing content experience: understands content types, review/approval steps, and translation/localization needs.
•  Experience integrating systems via API (webhooks, REST, or similar).
•  Working experience with Canva's API or Canva-based content generation workflows.
•  Experience translating process requirements or recommendations from a business or operations team into a technical build.
•  Strong written communication skills, able to explain technical workflows to non-technical stakeholders.
•  Ability to manage ambiguity and design for change in an evolving program.
•  Ability to see beyond a single project and connect build work to wider team or organizational initiatives.
Preferred Qualifications
•  Direct experience with ContentHub, Sitecore, Claude and/or ClickUp specifically.
•  Experience setting up or managing translation/localization pipelines.
•  Experience working alongside a process improvement, business analysis, or process review team.
•  Familiarity with content governance or AI guardrail frameworks in a regulated or specialized industry context.

title: AI-First Marketing Lead (m/w/d) - Remote
description:
refive is building the engagement layer for physical retail: digital receipts, QR/NFC touchpoints, and post-purchase journeys that help brands and retailers turn anonymous shoppers into known customers. We work with retailers like Puma, EuroShop, and Orlen and are scaling fast across Europe and beyond. We are a close-knit team, distributed across three continents, with a base in Berlin. We're building an AI powered startup, flat heirarchy and a tight, efficient team.
This is a Head of Marketing operating model inside a lean-team structure. You own the entire marketing function: strategy, content, SEO, events, partner co-marketing, and brand, and you run most of it through AI-powered workflows and agentic automation rather than headcount.
The bar is high: you need to zoom from annual content strategy to line-level copy review to prompting a new automation pipeline - and know which mode each situation calls for. We move in sprints, ship fast, and never let perfect be the enemy of good.
Tasks
• Content quality and brand voice: Own the editorial standard across everything that goes out — LinkedIn posts, blog content, SEO copy, case studies, newsletter. You are the last human filter before anything is published. You can tell the difference between content that performs and content that just sounds like AI generated it, and you fix the latter.
• AI content engine: Direct and maintain agentic pipelines that produce content at scale. You set direction, write the prompts, evaluate the output, and intervene when the machine gets it wrong. This is already partially built; you evolve and own it.
• Account-based marketing support: Align the content calendar with live pipeline priorities. Brief assets for key accounts. Make sure sales has what it needs, when it needs it — not generic collateral.
• SEO and inbound: Own organic growth. Blog strategy, keyword targeting, distribution playbook, conversion path optimisation.
• Brand and thought leadership: Evolve the Retail Spotlight podcast into a content ecosystem. Ghostwrite and direct founder voice content across two distinct voices. Build refive's presence as the authoritative voice on in-store customer engagement in Europe.
• Events and field: Project-manage event participation remotely — NRF, EuroShop, RTS London and similar. Own the full loop: logistics, pre-event content, on-site coordination with vendors and booth teams, lead capture workflows, post-event follow-up content. You run this independently; founders show up and present.
• Partner co-marketing: Develop joint campaigns and launch materials with white-label and integration partners as the pipeline scales.
• Metrics and reporting: Own the automated weekly marketing dashboard (GA4, HubSpot, LinkedIn). Know your numbers. Flag what is not working before anyone asks.
Requirements
• 6-8 years of B2B SaaS or tech marketing experience, with real ownership - not just execution support.
• You have run campaigns end to end and have results to show.
• Fluent, flawless native spokend and written english
• Agentic automation fluency. You have built or designed workflows using tools like Claude Code, n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar. You are comfortable prompting LLMs for structured outputs and wiring them into repeatable pipelines. This is not a nice-to-have it is how this role operates day to day.
• Strategic range with execution instinct. You can write a marketing plan in the morning and review a CTA in the afternoon. You know when to go deep and when to move on.
• Content quality instinct. You can tell the difference between AI-generated content that performs and content that just sounds like it was AI-generated. You write well yourself - sharp, no fluff, B2B-appropriate.
• Modern mindset, not stuck in old-school playbooks. Curious about what new tools can do, comfortable with ambiguity, willing to try things that have no case study yet - but experienced enough to know what good looks like and push back when a shortcut will cost you later.
• HubSpot and GA4 proficiency. You track what matters and use data to change direction, not validate decisions already made.
• Retail or martech experience is a genuine plus — if you understand how brick-and-mortar retailers think about footfall, loyalty, and first-party data, you will ramp faster and produce better work.
• One or more European language skills are a significant bonus given our primary market. But not a must have.
Benefits
• End-to-end ownership of a marketing function with real enterprise customers and a clear growth path
• The chance to build and document an AI-first lean marketing playbook - a genuinely novel problem
• Attractive compensation package and options after year 1
• Training budget and access to the latest AI tooling
• Direct access to the founding team and meaningful strategic input from day one
• Work from home or Goa or the mountains, wherever you want as long as you have a perfect internet connection
We use heavy agentic automation across content, research, and reporting. This role is not about doing more with less, it is about designing systems that handle the repeatable work so human judgment goes where it actually matters. If that excites you, you will fit here. If you prefer full manual control over every deliverable, this is probably not the right environment.
To apply, send your CV plus responses to both tasks below. Please use the "Cover Letter" field for that. Applications without both tasks completed will not be reviewed.
• Task 1: Editorial eye. Here is a LinkedIn post a retail tech founder drafted but never published: "Excited to share that we've just launched our new in-store customer engagement solution that helps retailers leverage data-driven insights to optimize their omnichannel strategy and drive meaningful ROI across touchpoints. This is a game-changer for the industry. #retail #innovation #customerexperience." Rewrite it. Then tell us in two sentences what was wrong with the original.
• Task 2: Systems thinking. We publish a new blog post every two weeks. Sketch the automation workflow you would build to turn each post into a week of LinkedIn content across two founder accounts. Cover: triggers, tools, prompts, and, critically, what a human reviews and when. A rough diagram or a numbered list of steps both work. We are not looking for a perfect answer. We are looking at how you think.

title: AI-Powered Live Events Marketing Executive
description:
AI-Powered Live Events Marketing & Social Media Executive (0–3 Years Experience)
Louder is an entertainment company, a specialist in promoting art and culture. We exist to showcase the talents of artists and develop audiences for their work. Louder produces 100+ club nights and other events every year, alongside entertainment products like ticketing, event management AI, CRM and gaming products.
We're looking for a marketer who uses AI tools and agents to do the work of a full marketing team. One person with the right AI stack can now produce what used to need a designer, a video editor, a copywriter, a media buyer and an analyst. If you don't already use AI every day to create and sell, this role is not for you.
This is a highly intense, result-oriented, full-time position based at our Lajpat Nagar, New Delhi office.
Key Responsibilities, and how AI helps
End-to-end marketing of entertainment events across the complete buyer's journey.
• Use AI to map each event's audience, plan the campaign timeline from announcement to sell-out, and write the messaging for each stage: awareness, early bird, urgency and last call.
Come up with creative ideas to design, communicate and market events.
• Brainstorm campaign concepts, hooks, stunts and themes with AI. Research what worked for similar artists and events worldwide, then test ideas quickly before spending money.
Plan, ideate, create and publish high-engagement content for YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, Spotify, Snapchat and wherever music fans gather.
• Generate platform-specific content ideas, trends, memes and hooks with AI. Repurpose one asset into many formats. Optimise content and pages so fans find our events on Google and when they ask ChatGPT or Gemini what's on.
Create social media designs, mini videos, reels, emailers, and motion graphics for events, contests and special days.
• Create posters, key visuals and ad variations with AI image tools (Midjourney, Ideogram, Firefly, Canva AI, ChatGPT / Gemini images). Make reels, teasers, lyric videos and motion graphics with AI video tools (Runway, Kling, Veo, Pika, CapCut AI). Cut long sets and aftermovies into dozens of clips automatically. Add AI voiceovers and dubs in Hindi, English and regional languages.
Develop social media strategies to increase engagement across our brands and client channels.
• Use AI to analyse what's performing for us and for competitors, find the best posting times and formats, and set up custom GPTs or Claude Projects trained on each brand's voice.
Plan each brand's monthly content calendar, including BAU, festive and marketing dates, plus year-long supplementary content.
• Have AI build first drafts of monthly and yearly calendars from our event schedule, festivals and trending dates, then refine them.
Deliver day-to-day promotional activities on time, from conception to completion.
• Use AI task lists, reminders and automations (Zapier, Make, n8n or our in-house agents) so routine posting and follow-ups run themselves.
Manage social media handles: content, posting, inbox and comment replies.
• Schedule with AI, use AI chatbots to answer fan DMs and ticket questions 24/7, and use AI social listening to track buzz and sentiment and react the same day.
Develop and run influencer marketing: find, qualify, negotiate with and contract influencers.
• Use AI to find influencers who fit each artist and city, check audience quality and fake followers, draft personalised outreach, and track results.
Sell events via email, SMS, WhatsApp, organic and paid digital, social media and ambassadors.
• Launch many AI-generated ad variations at once, let AI find winning audiences and shift budget to them. Set up AI-personalised email and WhatsApp flows: early-bird alerts, abandoned-cart nudges and last-call reminders.
Generate leads and pitch tickets, VIP packages and sponsorship proposals via calls, emails and messages.
• Use AI to research and build prospect lists of companies and brands, draft personalised pitches, and create sponsorship decks with AI-designed slides and audience data.
Submit grant applications for art programmes, events and festivals.
• Use AI to find relevant grants, check eligibility, and draft applications and reports to each funder's criteria.
Manage and update the CRM, tickets and VIP management, and build client, promoter, influencer and sponsor databases (PR, analytics and research).
• Use AI to clean and enrich contact data, write follow-ups, find PR contacts and turn campaign data into clear weekly reports on what sold tickets and why.
About You
• Hands-on experience creating content with AI tools. Please share a portfolio or links to AI-made creatives, videos or copy with your application.
• You know about new AI tools before your friends do, and you've already tried them
• Experience in, or a strong understanding of, marketing in music, media, culture or entertainment; ideally you've worked in events
• A track record of successful marketing campaigns, promotions or grant submissions
• A degree in Marketing, Advertising, PR or Communications, or an equivalent portfolio
• Knowledge of the pop-culture landscape and the workings of the entertainment industry
• Energy, a sense of humour, positive vibes, and an open and curious mind (yes, this makes a difference)
• The drive to take initiative, work independently and be accountable, while being a collaborative, positive and flexible team player
One More Thing
"It's not my job" isn't part of our vocabulary. We stuff envelopes. For a fake shaadi, we sourced every costume and element an Indian baraat needs, then found musicians in another country and briefed them on the songs and instruments so it went off seamlessly. We make mistakes, and we learn from them.

title: Content Marketer
description:
At Murf AI, we are simplifying voice integration and creation for builders and creators. Our Text-to-Speech platforms help developers build natural, responsive voice agents and enable enterprise teams to produce high-quality voiceovers and multilingual dubs with ease.
Some interesting facts about Murf AI: 
●Customers in 100+ countries 
● 8Mn+ registered users 
● 200+ voices in 35+ languages offered by Murf Studio 
● Rated by G2 as Top 10 Fastest Growing Products in 2024 & 2025 
● We are working on bleeding-edge research problems, in synthetic speech, and dubbing 
Job Summary 
We're looking for a Content Marketer to write, edit, and scale content across Murf's organic channels. You'll be part of the organic growth team to turn keywords/topics/customer queries into original blogs, landing pages, product teardowns, and product-led content — and you'll do it at a volume and quality bar that's only possible with AI-native workflows.
This is not a "write three blogs a month" role. We want someone who treats content production as a system: building briefs, running AI-assisted drafting pipelines, editing for accuracy and voice, and using data to decide what gets written next. We are looking for someone who can write genuinely helpful content that’s not a summary of a few articles from the internet.
Key Responsibilities 
Content Production & Scale
Write and edit content across Murf's organic channels — long-form blogs, landing pages, use-case and comparison pages, glossary and help content — aligned to search, customer queries and search-intent strategy.
Own the throughput and quality of the content pipeline: briefs in, publish-ready pages out, with clear turnaround times and quality gates
Operate and improve AI-native content workflows (LLM-assisted research, brief generation, drafting, humanizing, and pre-publish audits)
Refresh and consolidate existing content based on decay, cannibalization, and ranking data
SEO Collaboration
Partner with the SEO team on keyword research, SERP analysis, and content gap identification
Structure content for search — headings, entities, internal links, human-friendly formatting — and for AI search surfaces (AI Overviews, LLM citations)
Track performance in Google Search Console, Ahrefs, and analytics dashboards; use the data to prioritize what to write, update, or retire
Product & Brand Accuracy
Work closely with product, design, and customer-facing teams so content accurately reflects Murf's features, use cases, and positioning
Maintain Murf's tone of voice and editorial standards across every piece, whether written by a human, an AI, or both
Contribute to content guidelines, style rules, and QC checklists that keep quality consistent as volume grows
Required Skills and Qualifications 
• 3+ years of experience in content marketing, with a strong focus on SEO and organic growth
• Must have: prior experience at a B2B SaaS company, writing for technical or semi-technical buyers
• Well versed in AI-native content workflows — you've used LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) in a real production setting, not just for one-off drafts, and you have a point of view on where AI helps and where it hurts
• Genuine comfort with AI and technology as subject matter — you can explain how AI agents, voice AI and LLMs work to a non-expert reader without getting it wrong
• Working knowledge of SEO tools (Google Search Console, Analytics, Ahrefs or SEMrush) and the ability to analyze data
• Strong portfolio of published content with demonstrable ranking or traffic results
• Excellent editorial judgment: you can tell a good draft from a mediocre one and know exactly what to fix
• Structured, systems-minded approach to production — you think in briefs, templates, and repeatable processes
Good to Have
• Computer science or engineering background, or equivalent technical fluency
• Hands-on experience with content automation (e.g., multi-step LLM pipelines, MCP-connected tools, no-code/low-code automation)
• Familiarity with CMS platforms (Webflow, WordPress, headless CMS) and basic HTML/Markdown
• Experience writing for developer or API audience
Why Murf.ai? 
Murf AI is revolutionizing creative workflows for businesses through the utilization of our cutting-edge AI technology. Recognized as a consistent Leader and Momentum Leader on G2 in 2022 and 2023, we empower L&D and creative teams to evolve into dynamic creative powerhouses. With a focus on cutting-edge research and innovation, a positive work culture, and real impact in the AI-driven space, Murf.ai is one of the fastest-growing companies in the AI voice space. Join us at this pivotal moment, where your ideas matter, and your leadership can leave a lasting impact. If you're ready for a challenge and have the vision to lead from the front, Murf.ai is where your journey into the next chapter of AI innovation begins.

title: AI-First SEO Executive
description:
Job Title: AI-First SEO Executive
Experience: 2–3 Years
Location: Kochi, Kerala (In-office)
Department: Marketing
Reports To: Digital Marketing Manager
About The Role
We are hiring an AI-First SEO Executive. A forward-thinking role where AI automation and workflow design take center stage, while traditional SEO acts as the underlying domain where those systems are deployed.
In this role, your primary identity is an automation builder and AI leverage practitioner. You won't spend your days doing manual keyword research, line-by-line meta writing, or routine audits. Instead, your job is to engineer the AI workflows, LLM prompts, scripts, and automated pipelines that handle SEO tasks at 10x speed and scale. You will bridge the gap between AI capabilities and search growth.
Key Responsibilities
•  AI Systems & Workflow Automation (~65%)
• 
• Prompt Engineering & Pipeline Design: Design, test, and maintain structured prompt architecture (using OpenAI API, Gemini API, Claude) for complex SEO tasks like keyword research, SEO Reporting, bulk meta content creation, automated brief creation, and internal linking strategies.
• Workflow Automation: Build and deploy no-code/low-code pipelines (via Zapier, n8n, or Python/Google Apps Script) to automate repetitive tasks—such as automated crawl monitoring, ranking anomaly alerts, and new page publication updates.
• LLM & Custom Tool Deployment: Build custom GPTs, internal agents, and API-driven tools to automate content auditing, E-E-A-T checks, and competitor gap analysis.
• Generative Engine Optimization (GEO/SGE): Research, experiment with, and adapt to how AI search engines (Perplexity, ChatGPT Search, Google SGE/AI Overviews) crawl, cite, and retrieve information to ensure brand visibility across next-gen search interfaces.
• 
• AI Tool Stack Evaluation: Continuously test emerging AI marketing tools, APIs, and frameworks to evaluate ROI and integrate high-performing tools into the department's tech stack.
•  SEO & Execution (~35%)
• 
• Strategic SEO Oversight: Define technical and content SEO priorities (Core Web Vitals, site architecture, structured data) for AI systems to execute against.
• Quality Assurance & AI Content Auditing: Oversee and refine AI-generated outputs to guarantee technical accuracy, brand alignment, search intent match, and human-like natural language flow.
• Data & Performance Analytics: Use Google Search Console, GA4, Screaming Frog, and Looker Studio to track the actual organic growth impact of your automated systems.
• Topic Cluster Architecture: Define high-level pillar/cluster frameworks that automated workflows will build out and maintain.
Qualifications & Requirements• 
• Experience: 2–3 years of experience operating at the intersection of digital marketing, automation, and modern SEO workflows.
• AI-First Mindset: Demonstrated hands-on experience using LLM APIs, prompt engineering frameworks, and AI workflows to scale marketing outputs.
• Automation Fluency: Experience connecting systems via webhooks, APIs, and automation platforms ( Zapier, n8n) or writing custom scripts (Python, Google Apps Script, Node.js).
• SEO Fundamentals: Solid background in technical SEO, crawling/indexing concepts, structured data, search intent, and topical authority models.
• Problem Solver: Driven by systemic efficiency—always asking "How can an AI pipeline or script do this faster and better?"

title: Digital Marketing Director
description:
Zycus is looking for an agentic AI-native digital marketer to lead our digital marketing function across web, SEO, marketing automation, and performance. This is a hands-on lead role for someone who doesn't just use AI tools, but thinks and operates in an agentic-first way—building your own AI agents, automating workflows end-to-end, and using agentic AI as the default operating model, not a bolt-on. You will own the digital roadmap, manage the Martech stack, and be directly accountable for the organic and paid pipeline you generate, working closely with GTM, inside sales, and product marketing.
The ideal candidate is an agentic AI-native digital marketer: someone who is comfortable building, configuring, and deploying their own AI agents (using tools such as n8n, Zapier, Make, custom GPTs, or similar) to automate SEO audits, content workflows, campaign QA, and reporting—and who has a working understanding of AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), ensuring Zycus' content and website are optimized for visibility in AI-powered answer engines and generative search experiences (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, etc.), not just traditional search.
Key Responsibilities
Agentic AI, AEO & GEO
• Design, build, and deploy custom AI agents and automated workflows (e.g., using n8n, Zapier, Make, custom GPTs/Claude agents, or similar tooling) to automate SEO audits, content briefs, campaign QA, lead scoring, and reporting—reducing manual effort across the function.
• Identify high-impact use cases of where agentic AI can replace or augment manual digital marketing workflows, and drive adoption of these tools as standard operating practice.
• Own AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) strategy, ensuring Zycus' website and content are structured, cited, and optimized to appear in AI-powered answer engines and generative search experiences (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, etc.), in addition to traditional SEO.
• Continuously test and refine content structure, schema markup, entity optimization, and citation-worthiness to improve visibility and share of voice within AI-generated answers.
• Stay ahead of agentic AI capabilities, AEO/GEO best practices, and emerging AI-search behavior, keeping Zycus ahead of the shift from traditional SERPs to AI-mediated discovery.
Digital Strategy & Execution
• Define and execute strategic digital marketing initiatives across organic, paid, and owned channels, aligning execution to pipeline and revenue goals.
• Own end-to-end the website, blog, and corporate digital assets to ensure brand consistency, technical excellence, and performance optimization.
• Collaborate closely with GTM, inside sales, and product marketing leadership to align campaigns with business goals and drive account engagement.
SEO & Website Management
• Lead technical SEO, content SEO, and on-page/off-page optimization to drive organic growth, qualified traffic, and conversions.
• Use modern tools and AI-powered solutions to audit, monitor, and continuously improve SEO performance.
• Oversee conversion rate optimization (CRO) and A/B testing programs across the website to enhance user journeys and improve lead quality.
Marketing Automation & Martech
• Own and continuously optimize marketing automation and CRM workflows to ensure seamless nurturing, tracking, scoring, and lead lifecycle management.
• Use AI tools and behavioral data to optimize segmentation, personalization, and campaign automation.
• Continuously assess and evolve the Martech stack—evaluating additions, integrations, and improvements—and build the business case for new investments to leadership.
Demand Generation & Campaign Management
• Plan and execute targeted ABM campaigns in collaboration with GTM and product marketing teams.
• Leverage intent data, AI insights, and behavioral signals to improve targeting and messaging.
• Own digital advertising performance (Google, LinkedIn, Display) through data-led iteration, with a sharp focus on CAC and pipeline velocity.
Analytics, Insights & Forecasting
• Track and report on KPIs across the funnel—impressions, clicks, MQLs, SQLs, opportunities, and pipeline—and translate them into a narrative for leadership.
• Conduct rigorous A/B and multivariate testing to continuously improve performance.
• Use analytics, attribution modeling, and forecasting to maximize ROI, justify spend, and inform quarterly and annual planning.
Expertise and Qualifications
• 10–12 years of experience in digital marketing, with strong expertise in website management, SEO, automation, and analytics.
• Ideally BE in Computer Science / IT or a technical field.
• MBA preferred but not mandatory.
• Technically proficient in CMS platforms (e.g., WordPress), SEO tools (e.g., SEMrush, Screaming Frog, GA4), and Martech tools (e.g., Marketo, Salesforce, HubSpot).
• Deep understanding of AI tools and their application in digital marketing (e.g., ChatGPT, Jasper, Clearbit, Mutiny, etc.).
• Proven ability to build and deploy own AI agents and automated workflows using tools such as n8n, Zapier, Make, custom GPTs, or comparable platforms—this is a hands-on requirement, not just familiarity with AI tools.
• Strong working knowledge of AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), including how content structure, schema, and citations influence visibility in AI-powered answer engines and generative search results.
• Highly analytical with a growth-hacker mindset—comfortable using data to drive hypotheses, decisions, and improvements.
• Ability to think strategically and execute hands-on when needed.
• Experience in B2B SaaS or Enterprise software marketing is a strong plus.
Why Should You Join Us?
Five Reasons Why You Should Join Zycus
• Cloud Product Company: We are a Cloud SaaS Company and our products are created using the latest technologies like ML and AI. Our UI is in Angular JS and we are developing our mobile apps using React.
• A Market Leader: Zycus is recognized by Gartner (world's leading market research analyst) as a Leader in Procurement Software Suites.
• Move between Roles: We believe that change leads to growth and therefore we allow our employees to shift careers and move to different roles and functions within the organization.
• Get a Global Exposure: You get to work and deal with our global customers.
• Create an Impact: Zycus gives you the environment to create an impact on the product and transform your ideas into reality. Even our junior engineers get the opportunity to work on different product features.
About Us
Zycus is a pioneer in Cognitive Procurement software and has been a trusted partner of choice for large global enterprises for two decades. Zycus has been consistently recognized by Gartner, Forrester, and other analysts for its Source to Pay integrated suite.
Zycus powers its S2P software with the revolutionary Merlin AI Suite. Merlin AI takes over the tactical tasks and empowers procurement and AP officers to focus on strategic projects; offers data-driven actionable insights for quicker and smarter decisions, and its conversational AI offers a B2C type user-experience to the end-users.
Zycus helps enterprises drive real savings, reduce risks, and boost compliance, and its seamless, intuitive, and easy-to-use user interface ensures high adoption and value across the organization.

title: Content Marketer
description:
About HyperVerge
HyperVerge is a deep tech AI company providing identity verification solutions for companies in BFSI, Ed-tech, Telecom, Digital Lenders, and Marketplaces. Our homegrown AI powers large enterprises like Jio, SBI, and Bajaj Finserv, and has powered 2 billion+ AI-based automated ID checks. HyperVerge is on the path to $100M revenue and getting there requires exceptional content that unpacks complex ideas in AI and BFSI, builds trust with buyers, and drives organic and pipeline growth.
Mission
As Content Marketer at HyperVerge, you will build the narratives, frameworks, and content programs that drive growth, audience engagement, and sales pipeline. This is a high-ownership IC role. You will sit at the intersection of brand, PR, and email marketing. You will not just produce content, you will define what gets made, why, for whom, and how it performs.
Outcomes for the first year
Within the first 3–6 months:
• Publish a PR strategy covering target publications, executive positioning, narrative pillars, a reactive comms framework, and a quarterly pitch calendar
• Secure consistent earned coverage in tier-1 business and fintech publications through pitches, bylines, data stories, and expert commentary
• Set up and document the email infrastructure: domain strategy, authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), warm-up, suppression lists, and deliverability monitoring
• Define the email program structure: segments, cadences, nurture flows, and a newsletter with a clear editorial point of view
• Establish a reporting rhythm for both channels: coverage, share of voice, deliverability, engagement, and pipeline attribution
• Introduce AI tooling into both workflows and demonstrate measurable efficiency gains
Within the first year:
• Make HyperVerge a go-to source for journalists covering identity verification, AI fraud, and digital onboarding
• Run a healthy email program at scale with deliverability, bounce, and complaint rates within industry benchmarks and measurable pipeline contribution
• Build a library of reusable PR assets: executive bios, proof-point sheets, data stories, award submissions, and a crisis comms playbook
• Establish repeatable playbooks for both channels (launch PR cycle, reactive comms, nurture templates, list hygiene cycles) that can scale with the team
Responsibilities:
1. Public Relations & Media Relations
Own PR strategy and execution across business, fintech, technology, and trade media, building journalist relationships and placing press releases, bylines, and expert commentary.
2. Executive Positioning & Agency Management
Shape positioning for the CEO, CTO, and senior leaders through speaking opportunities, awards, and media prep, while managing the PR agency on briefing, approvals, and performance.
3. Reactive & Crisis Communications
Monitor news for moments where HyperVerge has a credible point of view and respond quickly, while maintaining holding statements and escalation paths for issues management.
4. Email Infrastructure & Deliverability
Own the email tech stack and sending infrastructure, including domains, authentication, warm-up, sender reputation monitoring, list hygiene, compliance, and rapid diagnosis of deliverability incidents.
5. Email Program & Performance
Design and run segmentation, nurture sequences, newsletters, launch campaigns, and sales-support sequences, with A/B testing and a performance dashboard tied to leads and pipeline.
6. Content & Brand Voice
Translate complex AI, identity verification, and BFSI concepts into clear narratives for journalists and buyers, keeping all PR and email output consistent with HyperVerge's brand voice.
7. Performance Monitoring & AI Adoption
Report on both channels to leadership on a regular rhythm and actively use AI tools for media research, pitch drafting, email copy, and deliverability analysis.
8. Cross-Functional Collaboration
Work with Product, Sales, BD, Growth, and Product Marketing to turn launches, proof points, and customer stories into press angles and email campaigns.
Requirements
Must Haves:
• An overall 2-3 years of experience, with a minimum of 1 year of hands-on PR experience (in-house or agency)
• A track record of securing earned media coverage: pitches that landed, bylines placed
• Strong writing and editing skills across press releases, bylines, pitches, and email copy
• Hands-on email marketing experience covering strategy, segmentation, copywriting, and performance tracking
• Working knowledge of email infrastructure and deliverability
• Experience operating at least one marketing automation or outreach platform
• Ability to analyse coverage and email performance data and make data-informed decisions
• Strong project management and self-organisation
• Comfort working cross-functionally
• Hands-on experience with AI tools
Good to Haves:
• Experience in BFSI, Fintech, SaaS, or enterprise technology
• Experience managing a PR agency as a client or working inside one
• Familiarity with cold outbound infrastructure (multi-domain setups, inbox rotation, warm-up tooling)

title: Content Marketer
description:
About CultureMonkey
CultureMonkey is building HR tech for companies that take people seriously.
We help organisations listen to their people better through employee engagement surveys, lifecycle surveys, pulse surveys, action planning, and people analytics. But the real thing we are building is not just software...
We are helping companies build workplaces where people feel heard, understood, and valued.
We are a fast-growing B2B SaaS company working with mid-market and enterprise customers across geographies. Over a million employees in 150+ countries trust us with something important: the honest voice of how they feel at work.
And the way people find us is changing fast. They do not just Google us anymore. They ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini. That shift is exactly where this role comes in.
About the Role
• We are looking for an AI Content Marketer who can make CultureMonkey the answer... on Google, and inside every AI engine people now ask first.
• This role sits right between content, SEO, product, and distribution.
• You will write content that HR leaders actually finish. You will make sure it ranks, gets cited, and keeps earning attention long after you hit publish.
• This is not a "write a blog and move on" role.
• This is a role about being remembered.
• You will own how a fast-growing brand gets found, read, and trusted in a search world that AI is rewriting in real time.
What You Will Do
• Write content people actually finish. Blogs, case studies, and playbooks that are clear, human, and genuinely useful.
• Write for the answer, not just the algorithm. Content built to rank on Google and get cited by AI engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.
• Use AI as a real part of your workflow, for research, drafting, and scaling, then edit hard so every piece stays accurate, original, and human.
• Run keyword and prompt research in Ahrefs and Search Console to publish content that ranks and holds its place.
• Refresh and re-optimize existing content so top pages keep their rankings as search intent and SERPs shift. Content decay is where organic traffic quietly leaks.
• Build domain authority through internal linking and structured outreach: guest posts, backlinks, and partnerships.
• Distribute with intent across newsletters, LinkedIn, Reddit, and product communities. Right message, right channel, right timing.
• Partner across teams on landing pages, sales and marketing emails, and ad copy, all research-backed.
• Track what matters, from CTR and organic traffic to keyword rankings and visibility in AI answers, and let the data shape the next draft.
• Most importantly... do not just write content that fills a calendar. Write the content that people, and AI, actually trust.
What We Are Looking For
• 1 to 2 years in content marketing, content writing, SEO, or a similar role where your writing had to perform, not just publish.
