title: Chief of Staff
description:
About Bright Money
Bright Money is a consumer fintech built for middle-income consumers. Our platform helps consumers build credit, manage debt, and access suitable loans and credit cards—addressing the key financial needs of people living paycheck to paycheck.
Bright is a profitable, India-built fintech serving the U.S. market, with a clear trajectory toward $100 million in revenue. Our business model combines subscription revenue with a financial-services marketplace across loans, credit cards, and credit-building solutions.
We have launched an AI-powered money assistant and agentic AI experiences that simplify access to credit. Our ambition is to build the first AI-driven consumer-fintech platform for middle-income consumers.
Founded in 2019, Bright’s founding team includes leaders from McKinsey’s Banking Practice—Petko Plachkov and Avi Patchava—and data science leaders from InMobi. Bright is backed by leading global venture capital firms and technology investors across the U.S., Europe, and Asia.
With a data-driven, high-ownership, and fast-paced culture, we are building a global consumer-fintech company from India.
What is the role about?
We are looking for a Chief of Staff (with a path to Chief Operating Officer) to work directly with Bright’s CEO and leadership team as a strategic partner and force multiplier. You will drive the company’s operating rhythm, translate strategy into execution across functions, and lead the high-priority initiatives that shape Bright’s next phase of growth.
This role is designed as a path to Chief Operating Officer. You will begin by driving strategy and execution alongside the CEO, and progressively take direct ownership of functions, teams, and P&L as you build the operating track record to step into the COO seat.
We are looking for a seasoned operator who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution, influences senior stakeholders without formal authority, and is ready to carry line accountability.
What will you do?
• Strategic partnership: Act as a thought partner to the CEO on company strategy, priorities, and key decisions—framing problems, analyzing options, and driving decisions to closure.
• Operating cadence: Own the company’s planning and review rhythm, including annual and quarterly goal-setting, OKRs, business reviews, and leadership meetings, with clear accountability and follow-through.
• Cross-functional execution: Lead high-priority initiatives from scoping through delivery, aligning Product, Engineering, Data Science, Growth, Finance, and Human Potential teams.
• Board & investor readiness: Prepare board decks, investor updates, and leadership communications with Board-level rigor and clarity.
• Performance insight: Track key business metrics and surface risks, bottlenecks, and opportunities early, with data-backed recommendations.
• Special projects: Own strategic projects such as new product or market evaluations, organizational design, and process improvements.
• Leadership leverage: Manage the CEO’s priorities and time, serve as a point of escalation, and represent the CEO in internal and external forums as needed.
• Path to COO: Progressively take direct ownership of functions, operating teams, and P&L, stepping into the Chief Operating Officer mandate as the business scales.
Ideal candidate profile
Experience & Background:
• Experience: 12+ years of professional experience, with a strong foundation in management consulting, investment banking, or strategy and operations roles at high-growth technology companies.
• Leadership exposure: A proven track record of working closely with founders or CXOs; prior experience as a Chief of Staff or in Strategy or BizOps leadership is strongly preferred.
• Domain: Experience in fintech, consumer internet, or financial services is a strong plus; exposure to the U.S. market is an advantage.
• Analytical depth: Strong quantitative and problem-solving skills; comfortable with financial models, business metrics, and data-driven decision-making.
• Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication, including Board-level presentations and executive storytelling.
• Education: Degree from a leading institution; an MBA is preferred.
• Operating scope: Experience owning a function, business line, or P&L, and building and leading teams; the ambition and readiness to step into a COO mandate.
Mindset & Operating DNA:
• Ownership: Treats company outcomes as their own and closes loops without being asked.
• Structured thinking: Brings clarity to ambiguous problems and turns them into actionable plans.
• Bias for action: Moves quickly, prioritizes ruthlessly, and balances speed with rigor.
• Influence without authority: Builds trust across teams and aligns senior stakeholders through credibility rather than hierarchy.
• Discretion & judgment: Handles sensitive information with integrity and makes sound calls under pressure.
• Leadership scale: Ready to move from influence to direct accountability—setting standards, building teams, and owning outcomes end to end.
Non-Fit Profiles
• Profiles focused mainly on executive assistance, scheduling, or administrative support.
• Candidates who prefer advisory work without hands-on ownership of execution and outcomes.
• Those uncomfortable with ambiguity, shifting priorities, or a fast-paced, high-cadence environment.
• Candidates seeking a long-term staff or advisory seat, with no appetite for line ownership or P&L accountability.
What Bright Offers?
• A profitable sub-unicorn with U.S. market scale – liquidity potential at $1–3B valuations.
• Real ownership: You grow into running your own BU with an independent P&L.
• Wealth creation: Equity at an inflection stage of scale.
• A data-driven, high-cadence culture that combines consulting rigor with FinTech speed.
• Benefits: Excellent benefits package in line with sector best practice.

title: Founder's Office - For a Software/AI portfolio company
description:
We are expanding the Founder's office of one of our fast growing portoflio company - SuperOps.
About SuperOps
SuperOps is a SaaS startup empowering IT service providers and IT teams around the world with
technology that is cutting-edge, future-ready, and powered by AI. We are backed by marquee investors like Addition, March Capital, Z47, Elevation Capital, and Tanglin Venture Partners.
Founded by Arvind Parthiban, a serial entrepreneur, built on the back of a team of engineers, product architects, designers, and AI experts, who want to reshape the world of IT. Now we have taken on a market that is plagued by legacy solutions and subpar experiences. The potential to do something great is immense. SuperOps serves thousands of IT service providers and IT teams in more than 100 countries, and tripled its customer base in the year to its Series C.
We also believe that the journey is as important as the destination. We want to build the best products out there and have fun while doing so. So come, be part of our A-star team of superheroes.
Location: based in Chennai or willing to relocate. Also transition to the US as the scope of the role grows.
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced Founder’s office /EIR to join the Founder’s Office and work on the company’s most important priorities, with a strong focus on go-to-market. This is not a program- management role: we want someone who shapes what we should do, makes the case with data, and then drives it through to results. 
You will work across Sales, Marketing, Product, Finance and Customer Success to find growth
opportunities, size them, build the plan and see it through. You will also be trusted to carry the Founder’s point of view into rooms he isn’t in. That means making sound calls within agreed guardrails, aligning leaders across functions, and escalating only what truly needs his attention.
As our leadership team increasingly operates across India and the US, this role will be a key anchor for strategy and execution in Chennai.
What You’ll Do
1) Drive GTM strategy and execution
• Own high-priority GTM initiatives end to end, from defining the problem through planning,
execution and measurable results.
• Work with Founder and the Sales, Marketing and Customer Success leaders on pipeline health,
funnel conversion, sales productivity, retention and expansion.
• Shape pricing and packaging, new segment and geography entry, partner and channel motions, and AI-led product launches.
• Build business cases, financial models and scenario analyses that lead to clear decisions on where to invest.
2) Drive Business Decisions
• Represent the Founder’s priorities and point of view in leadership forums and with teams, using judgment to make decisions rather than escalating every issue.
• Run the operating rhythm for key priorities: set goals, track progress, surface risks early and hold teams to outcomes.• Take on ambiguous, cross-functional problems that don’t sit neatly with any one team, and bring them to resolution.
3) Turn data into decisions
• Get to the right data quickly, understand what is really driving the numbers, and find the insight that matters.
• Tell a clear, persuasive story with data, through board and leadership materials, decision memos and business reviews, so leaders can act quickly.
• Track the SaaS, MSP and AI landscape, including competitors, market shifts and new business
models, and turn it into concrete recommendations for SuperOps.
What We’re Looking For
• Experience: 4–8 years across management consulting, strategy, business/revenue operations or GTM roles. Top-tier consulting (ideally MBB) followed by an operating role at a SaaS or technology company is a strong fit. An MBA from a Tier 1 institution is a plus.
• GTM depth: hands-on experience with GTM strategy and execution, such as pipeline and funnel economics, pricing, sales and marketing performance, or market expansion. B2B SaaS experience is strongly preferred.
• Exposure: to SaaS, enterprise software, or technology businesses is strongly preferred.
• Analytical rigour: comfortable working directly with data (advanced Excel/Sheets; SQL or BI tools a plus) and building models that drive decisions.
• Data storytelling: turns complex analysis into a crisp narrative and recommendation for the
Founder, leadership or the board.
• Strong Business Judegment that aligns senior stakeholders across functions and gets things done through others.
• Mindset: curious, low ego, comfortable with ambiguity, and steady under pressure.
What Success Looks Like
• First 90 days: build a deep understanding of SuperOps’ GTM engine and metrics, take ownership of 1–2 priority initiatives, and become a trusted partner to the leadership team.
• 6–12 months: deliver measurable impact on key GTM metrics, run the operating rhythm for
company priorities, and be the person leaders turn to for a clear, data-backed view, with the
Founder rarely needing to step in.
Why Join
This is a highly visible role with direct exposure to the Founder and leadership, at a pivotal stage in SuperOps’ global growth. You will learn how a global SaaS business is built and scaled from the inside, and for the right person the role can grow into a leadership position in strategy or a core business function

description:

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. • Define governance patterns for Agentic AI systems, including access controls, monitoring, auditability, and lifecycle management, partnering with R&D teams to ensure safe and responsible deployment
• Drive AI Academy initiatives in partnership with People and business leaders to build AI literacy, responsible AI awareness, and role-specific AI skills across the organization, developing adoption playbooks and enablement programs
• Develop governance metrics, executive dashboards, and reporting mechanisms to drive transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement across AI adoption and risk management
• Support strategic AI ecosystem partnerships, platform evaluations, and technology provider assessments, contributing to enterprise AI strategy, adoption roadmaps, and executive communications
The Impact You Will Have
• Shape how Synopsys governs, deploys, and scales AI technologies across 30,000 employees, establishing the foundation for responsible and secure AI adoption company-wide
• Enable business units and corporate functions to adopt GenAI and Agentic AI safely and effectively, reducing risk exposure while accelerating innovation velocity
• Build governance processes that protect Synopsys' intellectual property, customer data, and regulatory compliance posture as AI becomes embedded across products and operations
• Drive workforce readiness and AI literacy across the organization, ensuring employees have the skills and awareness to integrate AI into their daily work responsibly
• Establish Synopsys as a leader in enterprise AI governance, operationalizing best practices that set the standard for responsible AI adoption in the semiconductor and high-tech industry
• Provide executive leadership with visibility into AI adoption, risk posture, and business impact through metrics, dashboards, and reporting that inform strategic decision-making
• Create governance mechanisms that adapt to evolving AI technologies, regulatory requirements, and business needs, ensuring Synopsys stays ahead of the curve as AI capabilities advance
What You'll Need
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline
• 12+ years of experience leading complex enterprise-scale technical programs within software, semiconductor, cloud, AI, or high-tech environments
• Experience building or operating AI Governance, Responsible AI, technology risk, compliance, cybersecurity, or enterprise transformation programs
• Strong understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, Agentic AI, AI platforms, and AI adoption challenges within large organizations
• Experience coordinating cross-functional reviews involving Legal, Privacy, Cybersecurity, Compliance, Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders
• Familiarity with governance and risk frameworks such as NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, and emerging AI regulatory requirements is a plus,
• Experience with portfolio management and workflow tools such as Jira, SharePoint, Confluence etc. 
• Experience driving enterprise adoption, change management, workforce enablement, or AI upskilling initiatives is a plus
Who You Are
• You can translate complex AI governance and risk topics into clear, actionable guidance for executives, engineers, and business leaders without losing the technical nuance
• You influence across organizations and executive levels without direct authority, building trust and alignment through credibility, clarity, and follow-through
• You operate comfortably in ambiguity, building governance structures and processes in environments where technology, policy, and business objectives are evolving in real time
• You connect the dots between AI technology capabilities, governance requirements, risk management, and business value, ensuring that governance enables rather than blocks progress
• You manage multiple high-stakes initiatives simultaneously, keeping stakeholders aligned, timelines on track, and deliverables moving without dropping details
• You have a point of view on what good AI governance looks like and you are not afraid to push back when a policy is too vague, a process is too slow, or a risk assessment misses the actual exposure
The Team You'll Be Part Of
You will be part of the Strategic Missions & Technologies (SMT) organization, helping drive Synopsys' enterprise AI journey. The team partners closely with Engineering, Product, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, IT, People, IP group along with executive leadership to enable the responsible, secure, and scalable adoption of AI across the company. This role reports to the Head of AI Governance, Program Management and Chief of Staff for Strategic Missions & Technologies (SMT). This onsite role is based in Bangalore and requires regular collaboration with US-based teams, including overlap with Pacific Time hours.
Rewards and Benefits
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

title: Founder's Office
description:
This is an internal role at Weekday. Not a role by a client.
• Role type: Full time
• Location: Remote
• Working with: CEO and Cofounder
Weekday is an AI-native recruiting platform. We are backed by Y Combinator and Venture Highway (now General Catalyst). We have built the largest white collar talent database in India and have built tools to run outbound recruiting campaigns to them.
About The Role
You’ll work closely with the founders on some of the most important problems at the company.
There isn’t a fixed lane for this role. What you work on will depend on what the company needs at the time. That could mean figuring out why a product isn’t growing, launching a new product or market, improving an internal process, working with customers, researching a new opportunity, or taking on a project that simply doesn’t have an obvious owner yet.
This is a hands-on role. We’re not looking for someone whose job ends at analysing a problem and making a recommendation. You should be comfortable getting into the details and doing the work yourself.
As the company grows, the problems you work on will change. We expect the role to change with them.
What you’ll work on
Depending on the week, you might:
• Take a new idea from a rough hypothesis to something we can actually test
• Dig into a part of the business that isn’t working well, understand why, and fix it
• Work on growth for an existing product, including talking to customers, improving positioning, running experiments, or helping close important deals
• Research a new market, product, partnership, or business opportunity and decide whether it is worth pursuing
• Build a process or internal tool where none exists today
• Work with product and engineering to turn customer or business problems into product changes
• Take ownership of projects that cut across teams and would otherwise fall between the cracks
• Help the founders make decisions by getting to the underlying facts quickly
Some projects will last a few days. Others may become something you own for months.
What we’re looking for
• You’re good at figuring things out. You can take a vaguely defined problem, ask the right questions, and get to a useful answer without needing a detailed brief
• You’re comfortable doing the work yourself. If something requires talking to customers, going through data, writing copy, building a spreadsheet, or putting together a quick script, you’ll do it
• You have good business judgement. You can distinguish between something that is interesting and something that actually matters
• You’re comfortable with numbers and technology. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you should be able to work with data and use technology to make yourself more effective
• You communicate clearly. You can write well, explain what you’ve learned, and say when something isn’t working
• You take ownership. Once you take something on, the founders shouldn’t have to keep checking whether it is moving
• You care about details. A lot of this job involves noticing things other people miss and following through on them
• You’re comfortable with ambiguity. Priorities will change and you won’t always have a playbook to follow
We care less about whether you’ve had a “Founder’s Office” title before. You could come from startups, consulting, product, growth, operations, investing, or something else entirely. What matters is whether you can learn quickly and get useful things done.
What you get
You’ll work directly with the founders and get exposure to most parts of the company.
You’ll see how decisions get made, work on problems before they have dedicated teams around them, and have a lot of room to take ownership. If something you start becomes important enough, there’s a good chance you’ll continue to own it.
This role is a good fit for someone who eventually wants to build a company, run a business or product line, or become a generalist operator at an early-stage company.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

About The Health Insurance Industry –
While the current market sees more than 15 non-life players in the private space and 5 exclusive private players in the health insurance space trying to capture a sizable market share, the nationalized service provider (6) remains a strong competitor. In addition to this the business dynamics are such that the overall market on an annual basis which is to the tune of roughly 10,000 Crs sees close to 85 % of the business renewing with the existing service provider itself. This narrows down the opportunity of the fresh business actually being seriously fought in the market to approximately 1500 odd Crs. With the SME and the start-ups being the driving force of Indian economy, the opportunity to cater to these segments is immense and is increasing manifold year on year. The challenge here therefore remains as to how we capture a larger share of the opportunity by developing specific solutions to cater each segment of the business. Also by creating an inexpensive and standardized solution to increase the reach into the pockets of channel partners across the country to harness on their captive business and explore new opportunities with them.
Market Opportunities – With the advent of medical advancements, lifestyle changes, change in Indian socio-economic scenario and Indian healthcare space, and the insurers are facing challenges to cater to the needs of this diverse clientele. Increasingly Indian customers have started considering health insurance partners as extensions of health advisers. In this scenario it becomes extremely important to understand their psyche and then provide tailored solutions with wellness benefits which would help them meet their end objectives and bring in profitable revenue source for the company.
About The Aditya Birla Health Insurance –
Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited (ABHICL) was incorporated in 2015 as a 51:49 joint venture between Aditya Birla Capital Limited (ABCL) and MMI Strategic Investments (Pty) Ltd. ABHICL commenced its operations in October 2016.
ABHICL has entered the competitive health insurance market with an aim to expand the category to wider customer segments, beyond the ones that health insurance companies traditionally have marketed to. As the 6 th entrant in a category with well-established players, ABHICL is creating differentiation and equity for itself though the unique business proposition of “Health Insurance for All”, a one of a kind proposition in India at the moment. This is a philosophy that is being built through every single consumer touch point and into every single backend process of the company to ensure a customer’s experience of our proposition is continuous and seamless.
ABHI’s unique offering to market includes proposition includes -
•  A Comprehensive Incentivized Wellness Program that will attract the young and health conscious and will motivate, guide and reward them to stay healthy 
•  A Chronic Care Management Program to cater to the unmet needs of a growing Indian population of those suffering from chronic lifestyle conditions like Diabetes, Asthma, High Cholesterol and Hypertension from Day 1 
•  ABHICL serves as an enabler and influencer of health and healthcare choices that customers make, in addition to being a payer of healthcare expenses. Thus, ABHICL would act like a much needed catalyst to grow the prevalent health insurance landscape in India through product innovations and a wider choice of consumer relevant products. 
•  ABHICL’s vision has always been digital. The company has been successful in adopting paper-less approach right from identifying to on-boarding to delivering seamless experience of its customers & employees. 
Position Overview
This is a senior techno ? strategic role responsible for end ? to ? end ownership of ABHI’s innovation charter. The incumbent will operate as the enterprise thought leader for Gen ? AI and emerging technologies, guiding business units and leadership on capability prioritization and building, platform investments, risk governance, and long-term value creation. The role demands strong executive and cross-functional management, deep understanding of AI-driven enterprise transformation, strong vendor management, and the ability to convert complex technology into high-impact, multi-functional business outcomes.

• Run discovery sessions, interviews, and workshops with business teams to understand pain points, current processes, and the outcome they want

• Assess and rank ideas against business value, feasibility, data readiness, effort, and risk, and give the team a clear recommendation on what to build next

Define What Gets Built
• Map as-is and to-be processes, and identify where an AI agent, an automation, or a human-in-the-loop step fits best
• Write user stories, acceptance criteria, and edge cases that architects and builders can build from without guesswork
• Specify expected AI behaviour: what the solution should do, what it should never do, when it hands over to a person, and how answers will be checked for quality
• Prepare test scenarios and evaluation datasets with the builders to measure accuracy, reliability, and usefulness before launch
• Update initiative register
Prototype and Validate
• Use SQL, Python, or low-code tools to analyse process data, test assumptions, and build simple prototypes that prove an idea before engineering effort is committed
• Review APIs and system documentation to confirm integration feasibility with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday, and Microsoft 365
• Gather early user feedback on prototypes and turn it into prioritised backlog items
Support Delivery and Adoption
• Own and groom the product backlog, and take part in sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives
• Plan and run user acceptance testing with business users, and manage defects and feedback through to closure
• Partner with the Change Management & Evangelist and the Support Helpdesk to turn user questions and feedback into clear improvements
Measure and Share Value
• Capture baseline metrics before launch and track results afterwards, so every solution can show real impact
• Understand the Software Development Lifecylse to review adoption, continuous business iteration and value realization. 
• Maintain the use case library, requirement templates, and playbooks that make the next idea faster to shape
Have you got what it takes?
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience
• 5-8 years of experience as a Business Analyst or Systems Analyst in a software, technology, or digital transformation environment
• A programming background: hands-on experience writing code in at least one language such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or C#, plus working knowledge of SQL and REST APIs
• Proven skill in requirements engineering: process mapping, user stories, acceptance criteria, and traceability from need to delivered outcome
• Experience facilitating workshops and aligning senior business stakeholders with technical teams
• Experience working in Agile teams, with tools such as Jira and Confluence
• Working understanding of how large language models, RAG, and AI agents work and what they can and cannot do reliably, with hands-on use of AI assistants in your own work
• Some finance background or knowledge will be a plus
• Strong analytical, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical ideas in plain business language
• Fluency in English
You will have an advantage if you also have:
• Hands-on experience on AI, GenAI, or automation projects, from use case definition through to production
• Experience with low-code or agent-building tools such as Claude, Microsoft Copilot Studio or similar
• Background in CX, contact centre, CCaaS, or enterprise SaaS environments
• Familiarity with evaluating LLM output quality, including test set design and acceptance thresholds
• Business analysis certification such as CBAP or PMI-PBA
• Experience working across regions and time zones, with teams in International and the Americas
What’s in it for you?
SPARK is a chance to be a founding member of a brand-new team, and to shape how NiCE turns AI ideas into everyday tools used by colleagues around the world.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
About Digital Human Health (DHH)
Digital Human Health (DHH) connects technology, data, and people to enable and accelerate Human Health business across global markets. DHH supports commercial and medical teams by delivering customer-centric digital platforms, data capabilities, and technology-enabled operating models that enable flexible go-to-market approaches, actionable insights, and personalized customer experiences in a regulated environment.
Within DHH, the Content Creation & Storage pillar of Digital Content & Customer Experience (DCCE) builds the platforms and capabilities that help Human Health create compliant, on-brand content faster. As part of the Content Accelerator, the pillar is moving content creation from manual production to AI-generated content that is built to brand and compliance standards from the start, combining agentic content creation platform, Adobe capabilities (including Adobe Brand Intelligence and Adobe Firefly), design system, and AEM/DAM foundations.
Role Purpose 
Act as hands-on business and product partner for AI-enabled content creation, working closely with business users and vendor teams to shape, test, and evolve GenAI and agentic capabilities, and building the internal knowledge needed to confidently own custom components as the platform landscape evolves.
Scope Of Ownership & Adjacent Responsibilities
• Support the AI Content creation workstream experiment design, requirements, testing, and assessment of where Adobe capabilities can replace or complement custom-built components. 
• Build working ownership of custom agentic components. Understand how they work, maintain requirements and backlog, and guide their evolution with engineering and vendor teams. 
• Support the Adobe Firefly rollout across Human Health access and onboarding inputs, playbook and enablement content, usage reporting, and user feedback loops. 
• Work closely with content creators, brand teams, and reviewers to capture real feedback, prioritize the most important items, and turn them into fast, practical iterations. 
• Flex across adjacent workstreams in the pillar (e.g., design system, guardrails/rules, AEM/DAM) as priorities shift. 
Key Responsibilities
Business Analysis & Product Ownership Support 
• Translate business and workflow needs into clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria for AI-enabled content creation capabilities. 
• Maintain and prioritize backlogs in partnership with the Product Owner; support sprint planning, refinement, and release readiness. 
• Map current-state and future-state content creation workflows, identifying where AI and agents add value and where human review remains essential. 
• Facilitate UAT with business, brand, and compliance stakeholders; track defects, gaps, and fixes through to closure. 
Hands-on GenAI & Agentic Delivery (Embedded with the Business) 
• Work hands-on with GenAI and agentic tools to test, configure, and validate capabilities (e.g., prompts, agent inputs/outputs, brand rules, assembly and validation steps). 
• Sit close to business users during pilots and early rollout observe real usage, unblock issues quickly, and feed priority learnings back into the backlog. 
• Design and run structured experiments with clear scope, success criteria, test assets, and results (e.g., accuracy, false-flag rate, turnaround time, rework). 
• Build a working understanding of component architecture, integrations, and APIs to have informed discussions with engineering and vendors. 
Platform & Vendor Collaboration (Adobe and Partners) 
• Serve as a day-to-day contact for Adobe and implementation partners on ABI and Firefly align on scope, prerequisites, dependencies, and timelines. 
• Assess build vs. buy trade-offs for components (custom vs. platform capability) and document recommendations with risks and dependencies. 
• Review vendor deliverables (playbooks, guides, configurations) to confirm fit needs and governance. 
Documentation, Governance & Communication 
• Maintain a clear source of truth (e.g., Confluence, JIRA) covering requirements, decisions, test results, and component documentation. 
• Embed compliance-by-design human-in-the-loop controls, AI labeling, auditability, and alignment with AI and content policies. 
• Prepare crisp updates, MoMs, and decision summaries for leadership and cross-functional stakeholders. 
What Success Looks Like
• We have internal capability to understand, maintain, and evolve custom content creation components with reduced dependence on vendors. 
• ABI experiments run to plan with clear results that support evidence-based platform decisions. 
• Firefly adoption grows across Human Health with users onboarded, enabled, and supported within guardrails. 
• Business feedback turns into prioritized improvements quickly, with visible gains in turnaround time, rework, and first-time-right content. 
• Requirements, decisions, and component documentation are current, traceable, and reusable. 
Qualifications & Experience
Education 
Bachelor’s degree required; master’s degree preferred.
Experience
• 4–5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, Product Manager/Owner, or similar role in digital products or technology delivery. 
• Hands-on experience with GenAI tools or solutions, e.g., building, configuring, or testing prompts, AI workflows, agents, or LLM-based applications—beyond awareness level. 
• Exposure to agentic AI concepts (agents, orchestration, tool use, human-in-the-loop) and practical experience in pilots, proofs of concept, or early rollouts. 
• Experience working directly with business users in a delivery-embedded or customer-facing role, turning feedback into rapid iterations. 
• Strong requirements, user story, and process mapping skills; experience in Agile/Scrum with tools such as JIRA and Confluence. 
• Working technical literacy APIs, integrations, data inputs/outputs, and the ability to engage credibly with engineers and vendors. 
• Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to work across a geographically distributed team (India, Europe, US). 
Preferred / Nice To Have
• Experience with Adobe content ecosystem (Firefly, GenStudio, Express, AEM Assets, Workfront) or similar marketing/content technology. 
• Familiarity with design systems or Figma-based creative workflows. 
• Experience in pharma or other regulated environments; awareness of MLR/content review and AI governance considerations. 
• Experience with prompt engineering, basic scripting (e.g., Python), or low-code/AI agent builders. 
Key Competencies 
• Business-first problem solving with a bias for hands-on delivery 
• Ownership and learning agility in fast-changing AI platforms 
• Clear, concise communication and decision-ready documentation 
• Collaboration across business, engineering, and vendor partners

title: TE-1520 -AI-First Business Analyst / Product Owner
description:
Eden Health | Engineering and Product Hub, India
AI-First Business Analyst / Product Owner
Location: Hyderabad (Eden Health Engineering and Product Hub, India)
Experience: 6 to 10 years
Employment: Full time
Shift: US overlap required
About Eden Health
Eden Health is a US healthcare company delivering exceptional healthcare experiences through technology. Eden has set up a dedicated Engineering and Product Hub in India in partnership with Softobiz Technologies, to expand engineering capacity, speed up innovation and strengthen its AI and data capabilities.
We are now building the next version of Eden’s platform: a connected healthcare ecosystem that brings patients, doctors, care teams and partners such as clinics and pharmacies together on one modern, cloud-native foundation. The India hub is at the centre of that build.
AI is central to how Eden will grow, from clinical decision support to operational automation. The India hub works hand in hand with Eden’s US leadership, with real ownership across product, engineering and operations.
Read the announcement: Expanding Our Digital Footprint in India
About The Role
You’ll own how parts of Eden’s next-generation platform work for the people who use them: patients, doctors, care teams and partners. You’ll take a problem from the first conversation to a live feature: understand it deeply, shape the solution, prototype it with AI, get it built and prove it worked.
We’re looking for a product thinker who is also hands-on. Someone who can sit with a support agent in the morning, prototype a new flow with AI by lunch, and walk engineers through crisp stories in the afternoon. You’ll own a delegated product area and its backlog, in line with the roadmap set by Eden’s US product leadership.
What AI-first Means Here
• Think AI: For every journey, you ask where AI could remove friction for patients or effort for care teams, and you can build the business case for it.
• Use AI: AI tools are part of how you research, make sense of user feedback, write PRDs and stories, and analyse data every day.
• Prototype with AI: You turn ideas into clickable or working prototypes in hours, so stakeholders react to something real.
• Shape AI features: You scope AI features with care, covering expected behaviour, edge cases, guardrails and how success will be measured.
What You’ll Do
Own a product area
• Own a delegated product area and its backlog, in line with the roadmap set by Eden US.
• Make clear prioritisation calls based on patient impact, business value and effort, and explain the why.
• Define success metrics for every feature and track them after launch.
Discover and shape
• Work closely with stakeholders across Product, Member Care, Marketing and Operations, and with the people who use the platform every day.
• Use AI to dig through support tickets, usage data and feedback to find what’s really slowing people down.
• Shape journeys for patients, doctors, care teams and partners, and how they connect.
• Prototype solutions with AI and test them with users before engineering commits.
Build the next version
• Help define how the next version of the platform works, making every journey simpler, faster and more connected.
• Write user stories, acceptance criteria and flows that engineers can build from with confidence.
• Run refinement, sprint reviews and user acceptance testing with engineering and design.
• Work with Service Delivery and Support so every release lands well with the people who use it.
Must have
• 6+ years as a Product Owner, Product Manager or Senior Business Analyst on digital products.
• A track record of shipping features end to end, from discovery to measurable results.
• Hands-on daily use of AI tools for research, writing and analysis, with examples to show.
• Experience building prototypes with AI or no-code tools.
• Strong story writing and backlog management in Jira or similar tools.
• Comfortable with data: basic SQL or dashboards for validating decisions.
• Confident working with senior US stakeholders, with excellent written and spoken English.
Nice to have
• Healthcare or telehealth domain knowledge, including HIPAA awareness.
• Experience building a new product or platform from the ground up.
• Experience on platforms that serve multiple user groups or partners, such as marketplaces or B2B2C products.
• E-commerce, subscriptions or payments product experience.
• CSPO or PSPO certification.
What Success Looks Like In Your First 6 Months
• You own a product area, and the team knows what’s being built and why.
• At least one feature you shaped is live, with metrics showing its impact.
• Your AI prototypes have sped up at least one key decision with Eden US.
• Engineers build from your stories with confidence and few follow-up questions.
Why join
• Shape the next version of a healthcare platform from the ground up.
• Be part of the founding team of Eden’s India Engineering and Product Hub, with a real say in what gets built.
• Work directly with Eden US product leadership on healthcare technology that genuinely matters.
• Join an AI-first culture where the best tools are part of how everyone works.
How We’ll Assess You
• Walk us through a product decision you owned: the problem, the options, your call and the result.
• Show us a prototype, PRD or set of stories you’ve produced, ideally with AI.
• Expect a live exercise: we give you a real-world healthcare problem, and you use AI tools to shape it into a prototype or scoped feature with stories and success metrics.
• Expect a conversation with product and engineering leadership about how you prioritise and handle stakeholders.

title: AI Business Analyst – Applied & Agentic AI Systems
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
The Position
About The Role
At Roche Digital Technology (RDT), we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. As part of our strategic initiatives, we enable high-value AI solutions (with a strong focus on Generative AI and agentic systems) through fit-for-purpose platforms, services, and applications. The Applied AI Engineering Team is tasked with building innovative AI applications, GenAI agents, and agentic foundations.
In the 2026 tech landscape, the lines between traditional disciplines have blurred. We operate in small agile teams (typically ~9 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before (Agentic SDLC).
To support our rapid-turnaround, high-velocity engineering teams, we are seeking a highly skilled, deeply experienced IT Business Analyst. Operating in a highly regulated pharmaceutical and clinical environment (GxP), you will serve as the strategic interface between complex business priorities, regulatory compliance frameworks, and cutting-edge engineering realities. You are not a traditional analyst who merely documents requests; you are a passionate, technically literate individual contributor equipped with advanced AI skills (including prompt engineering & modern agentic workflows) and the business acumen to collaborate closely with product leaders. Furthermore, you possess strong Product Owner (PO) skills and are fully prepared to confidently act as a Proxy PO for the squad if necessary—managing the product backlog, defining sprint goals, and steering delivery timelines to align with Roche’s strategic objectives.
Core Tech Stack & Scope
This role requires a deep understanding of three core domains: AI systems, the life sciences and pharmaceutical business context, and the complexities of operating within a highly regulated environment.
The IT Business Analyst serves as the strategic bridge between complex business requirements and cutting-edge technical execution. You will take ownership of the end-to-end requirements lifecycle for AI initiatives, ensuring that all architectural designs and engineering deliverables are scalable, high-performing, and strictly compliant with global regulatory standards. By aligning technical roadmaps with strategic priorities, you will drive the delivery of robust AI solutions that provide measurable business value and maintain the highest levels of data integrity and quality assurance.
Key Responsibilities
Agile Requirements & Product Owner Support (60% Focus):
• Manage the full AI project lifecycle from opportunity identification through deployment and value realization
• Translate business goals into prioritized product backlogs, Epics, and User Stories with clear acceptance criteria
• Define MVP/MMR strategies to iteratively deliver business value while managing project risks
• Act as a Proxy PO when necessary, making critical decisions on prioritization and sprint goals
LLM Prompt Engineering & Solution Prototyping:
• Design and optimize LLM prompts to ensure accurate, secure, and relevant model outputs
• Prototype agentic workflows and evaluate model responses using Python scripting and SQL data exploration
• Develop specifications for dynamic Generative UI components and RAG pipeline context mappings
Requirements Engineering & Business Process Analysis:
• Lead requirements workshops and JAD sessions to elicit business and functional specifications
• Author standard-compliant artifacts including URS, FRS, and "as-is/to-be" process maps
• Conduct gap analyses and re-engineering assessments to optimize and automate manual workflows
GxP Compliance, Computerized System Validation (CSV) & Software Assurance (CSA):
• Guide compliance-by-design strategies for AI deployments following GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, and Annex 11
• Guide risk-based CSA/CSV activities, authoring risk assessments (FMEA), trace matrices, and validation reports
• Enforce strict data integrity controls (ALCOA+) and system classifications to preserve validated states
AI Governance, Risk Management & Observability Specifications:
• Ensure governance guardrails, escalation triggers, and observability requirements for agentic AI systems are applied
• Assess AI-specific risks (drift, leakage, tool misuse) and formulate TCO/ROI business cases
Change Control, ITSM & Configuration Management:
• Manage formal Change Requests (RFC) and present impact analyses to CAB/ECAB boards
• Maintain system configuration documentation and audit-readiness for internal and regulatory inspections
Audit Readiness & Operational Support:
• Act as IT SME during audits, presenting validation evidence and requirements engineering practices
• Author SOPs, manuals, and training materials to support business readiness and operational transitions
Practical Skills Required
Experience:
• 8+ years of IT Business Analysis experience supporting enterprise-scale software solutions, system integrations, and business processes
• 5+ years of experience in highly regulated environments, with a strong preference for the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical devices, or clinical healthcare sectors
• 3+ years of proven experience in Agile/Scrum product delivery, with demonstrated success managing product backlogs, writing detailed User Stories, and supporting agile ceremonies
• Hands-on AI/LLM Project Experience: Experience working directly on Generative AI or machine learning projects, supporting data preparation, prompt development, or AI application testing
• Proven track record of delivering computerized system validation or software assurance under industry-standard quality guidelines and electronic records regulations
• Demonstrated experience working with cross-functional, globally distributed engineering squads (including developers, architects, QA, and validation teams)
• Agentic Workflow / aSDLC Experience: Proven experience leveraging AI productivity tools and writing/coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, ChatGPT, Codex, GitHub Copilot) daily to accelerate elicitation, business process mapping, and requirements generation within an agentic software development lifecycle
Skills
Must-have:
• Advanced Requirements Lifecycle Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in elicitation, specification, modeling, verification, and traceability
• LLM Prompt Engineering & AI Prototyping: Proficient in designing, evaluating, and refining prompts for large language models. Ability to construct robust system prompts and templates that control model outputs and behavior
• Technical & Data Literacy (Analysis & Logical Assessment): Advanced ability to analyze complex data structures, logically assess AI model outputs, and trace data lineage. Strong technical aptitude to interpret technical specifications and evaluate system behaviors, with a focus on data-driven decision-making rather than hands-on coding or scripting
• Regulatory & Quality Expertise: Deep theoretical and practical knowledge of industry-standard regulatory and quality protocols, software validation and quality assurance standards, and global guidelines for electronic records and digital signatures
• Process Modeling & Visualization: Advanced skills in process mapping, business workflow design, and data flow diagramming using tools like Microsoft Visio, Lucidchart, or BPMN engines
• Business Case & Financial Analysis: Experience conducting financial analyses, cost-benefit modeling, and calculating the total cost of ownership for enterprise platforms
• Stakeholder Management & Facilitation: Outstanding active listening, communication, and negotiation skills, with the ability to build consensus across conflicting viewpoints, push back on unrealistic business requests, and translate between "business speak" and "tech speak."
Should-have
• Agile Product Ownership Capability: Strong product thinking and backlog management capabilities using JIRA and Confluence. Ability to confidently step in as a Proxy PO when necessary to define MVPs, prioritize backlogs, and drive sprint goals
• AI/ML and Agentic Architecture Familiarity: Broad understanding of LLM architectures, RAG/GraphRAG concepts, multi-agent frameworks, and vector/graph databases to effectively analyze requirements for advanced AI projects
• IT Service Management (ITSM): Solid understanding of ITIL-based change management, incident management, and CMDB architectures
• Testing and QA Partnership: Experience partnering with QA to review test plans, coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and verify test coverage using Requirements Traceability Matrices
• Agentic SDLC: Strong drive to apply agentic Software Development Lifecycle practices and tools
Could-have:
• Professional Certifications: International Institute of Business Analysis (IIBA) credentials such as CBAP (Certified Business Analysis Professional) or CCBA; Project Management Institute (PMI-PBA) or Scrum Alliance (CSPO/PO) certifications
• Multicloud Awareness: Basic familiarity with cloud service models (AWS/Azure) and cloud-native application deployments
Capabilities:
• Problem-Solving Skills: Dissect complex, ambiguous, and abstract business challenges into manageable, structured, and verifiable functional requirements
• Ownership & Decisiveness: High-ownership mindset with the confidence to make tough priority decisions, remove development roadblocks, and step in to lead product direction as a Proxy PO when necessary
• Consulting & Trust: Ability to serve as a strategic, trusted advisor to senior business stakeholders, QA leads, and engineering teams, translating seamlessly between clinical business speak and technical developer speak
• Ethics & Empathy: Deep commitment to patient safety, product quality, data security, and ethical AI deployment, backed by a strong user-centric design approach
Qualifications
The successful candidate should:
• Have a strong understanding of both AI applications and traditional software development life cycle (SDLC) methodologies
• Be passionate about AI, staying up-to-date with emerging digital trends, software architectures, prompt engineering, and validation practices
• Be team-oriented, proactive, and collaborative, with a proven ability to thrive in a high-velocity, fluid, and multidisciplinary agile environment where roles are fluid
• Be detail-oriented, highly organized, and an exceptional problem-solver who takes initiative in identifying and solving problems
• Be willing to learn and expand their skill set in an environment where roles are fluid and multidisciplinary
• Be able to communicate in English at the level of: C1+
Located in Hyderabad, India, with working hours structured to capture the "golden hours" of overlap with Central European Time (typically running through the IST evening).
Why Join Us?
• Innovative Environment: Collaborate with a highly advanced, autonomous squad pioneering agentic AI and GenAI systems in healthcare
• Growth Opportunities: Bridge the gap between innovative technologies and critical, life-saving regulatory standards, expanding your skills into Product Ownership and Prompt Engineering
• Collaborative Culture: Be a part of a diverse and inclusive team that values technical excellence, strategic thinking, and creative leadership
Shift: CET time zone
#Hyderabad2026
Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
Let’s build a healthier future, together.

title: Specialist, Business Analyst – Content Studio
description:
Job Description
About Digital Human Health (DHH)
Digital Human Health (DHH) connects technology, data, and people to enable and accelerate Human Health business across global markets. DHH supports commercial and medical teams by delivering customer-centric digital platforms, data capabilities, and technology-enabled operating models that enable flexible go-to-market approaches, actionable insights, and personalized customer experiences in a regulated environment.
Within DHH, the Content Creation & Storage pillar of Digital Content & Customer Experience (DCCE) builds the platforms and capabilities that help Human Health create compliant, on-brand content faster. As part of the Content Accelerator, the pillar is moving content creation from manual production to AI-generated content that is built to brand and compliance standards from the start, combining agentic content creation platform (Content Studio), Adobe capabilities, and the design system.
Role Purpose
Own business analysis for Content Studio, AI-enabled content creation capability. Turn business needs into clear, build-ready, and traceable requirements, and work hands-on alongside engineering, UX, and implementation partners from discovery through release.
The role is the Product Owner’s day-to-day partner. As the person grows, they will be expected to take on product ownership for defined Content Studio features or components, including backlog decisions, stakeholder alignment, and release outcomes.
Scope of Ownership & Adjacent Responsibilities
Accountable for (owns the deliverable and its quality) 
• Content Studio requirements functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria for assigned features and components.
• Backlog readiness stories meet the agreed Definition of Ready before sprint planning.
• The product source of truth (Confluence/JIRA) workflows, business rules, input/output requirements, integrations, known limitations, and the decision log.
• Requirements traceability from business need to story, test, and released functionality.
• UAT coordination with business users, including tracking feedback and gaps through to closure.
• The user feedback loop capturing feedback from content creators, brand teams, and reviewers, and turning it into prioritized backlog items.
Partners on (contributes; another role makes the final decision) 
• Backlog prioritization and release scope, with the Product Owner.
• Solution design and technical approach, with engineering and implementation partners.
• Integration requirements with adjacent platforms (e.g., Adobe capabilities, design system, guardrails/rules engine, Veeva Vault PromoMats), with the respective product teams.
Adjacent 
• Flex across other Content Creation & Storage workstreams (e.g., Adobe Brand Intelligence experiments, design system) as priorities shift.
Key Responsibilities
Requirements & Backlog Ownership
• Run discovery with business users to understand workflows, pain points, and desired outcomes before writing requirements.
• Write user stories with clear acceptance criteria, edge cases, and dependencies, and resolve open questions before development starts.
• Prepare refinement and sprint planning with the Product Owner. Bring a ready, sized backlog and a recommended priority order.
• Turn workflows into clear product behavior, including user flows, error handling, and human-in-the-loop review points.
• Manage requirement changes and log scope decisions so everyone knows what changed and why.
Working with Tech Teams & Validation
• Work closely with engineering during sprints to clarify requirements and resolve open questions quickly.
• Get hands-on with Content Studio’s AI features (e.g., prompts, agent inputs/outputs, brand rules) to understand how they behave and confirm they meet requirements.
• Build a working understanding of the platform’s architecture, integrations, and APIs to have informed discussions with engineering and partners.
• Coordinate UAT with business users, capturing feedback, defects, and gaps and following them through to resolution.
Documentation, Governance & Communication
• Keep the Content Studio source of truth current and easy to understand for new team members, business users, engineers, and partners.
• Maintain the decision log, open questions, risks, and dependencies across internal and partner teams.
• Build compliance into requirements, including human-in-the-loop controls, AI labeling, auditability, and alignment with AI and content policies.
• Share concise updates on progress, decisions, risks, and releases with the Product Owner and stakeholders.
Stakeholder & Vendor Collaboration
• Facilitate requirement workshops and working sessions that end in clear decisions and owners.
• Review vendor and partner solutions against documented requirements, and raise gaps early.
• Act as the bridge between business and technical teams so both share the same understanding of what is being built and why.
What Success Looks Like
• Stories reach sprint planning ready to build, with little rework or mid-sprint clarification.
• Content Studio has one current, trusted source of truth that engineers, partners, and new joiners actually use.
• Every released feature can be traced back to a business need and an agreed acceptance test.
• Delivered features match what the business asked for, with gaps caught early through UAT.
• User feedback is turned into prioritized improvements quickly and visibly.
• Over time, the person independently owns defined features or components end to end, showing readiness for a Product Owner role.
Qualifications & Experience
Education
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field required; Master’s degree preferred.
Experience
• 4–5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or Product Owner/Manager in digital products or technology delivery.
• Hands-on experience with GenAI tools or solutions, e.g., building, configuring, or testing prompts, AI workflows, agents, or LLM-based applications, beyond awareness level.
• Understanding of agentic AI concepts (agents, orchestration, tool use, guardrails, human-in-the-loop) and practical experience in pilots, proofs of concept, or early rollouts.
• Strong requirements, user story, acceptance criteria, and process mapping skills; experience in Agile/Scrum teams using JIRA and Confluence.
• Working technical literacy APIs, integrations, and data inputs/outputs, with the ability to engage credibly with engineers and vendors.
• Experience supporting UAT and validating solutions against requirements.
• Experience working directly with business users and turning feedback into rapid iterations.
• Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to work across a geographically distributed team (India, Europe, US).
Preferred / Nice To Have
• Experience with content management, marketing technology, Digital Asset Management, or content supply chain platforms.
• Familiarity with the Adobe content ecosystem (e.g., Firefly, AEM Assets, Workfront) or Veeva Vault PromoMats.
• Familiarity with design systems or Figma-based creative workflows.
• Basic scripting or query skills (e.g., Python, SQL) or experience with low-code/AI agent builders.
• Product Owner certification (e.g., CSPO, PSPO) or experience owning backlog decisions for a product or feature area.
• Experience in pharma or other regulated environments; awareness of MLR/content review and AI governance considerations.
Key Competencies
• Ownership and accountability for deliverables
• Business-first, hands-on problem solving
• Attention to detail and strong analytical thinking
• Learning agility in a fast-evolving AI environment
• Clear, concise communication and documentation
• Strong cross-functional collaboration

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
Roboyo AI is a category shaper in Applied AI and Agentic Automation. We help leading enterprises move from automation projects and AI experiments into governed, production-grade systems that execute real work across workflows, processes, products and services. 
Our heritage is in scaled enterprise automation; our future is Applied AI and Agentic Automation: autonomous agents, AI engineering squads, process orchestration, data and knowledge foundations, and human-in-the-loop governance embedded deeply into how our clients operate. 
We are not here to sell AI theatre. We are here to turn AI into working systems, measurable outcomes and repeatable transformation programs. 
 About the role
This is an end-to-end ownership role. The Senior Business Analyst (BSA) is accountable for the business-facing thread of an automation or AI initiative from first stakeholder conversation to post-production stabilisation. You will run process discovery and feasibility assessment, define and baseline requirements, partner with architects and developers through build, own functional and user acceptance testing, support go-live and hypercare, and hand over a fully documented, measurable solution to the client and support teams. You are expected to operate independently on complex processes, mentor junior analysts, and be the person the client trusts to tell them what is genuinely automatable and what is not. 
Key Responsibilities 
• Lead structured discovery workshops, stakeholder interviews, job shadowing and process walkthroughs with business SMEs to capture the true operating process, including exceptions, workarounds and undocumented tribal knowledge. 
• Perform automation feasibility and complexity assessment; qualify or disqualify candidate processes against standardisation, rule-clarity, volume, stability and data-quality criteria, and have the confidence to recommend against automation where the business case does not hold. 
• Build the business case: quantify AS-IS effort, volumes, FTE cost, error rates and cycle times; model expected benefit, ROI, payback period and effort estimate, and present it to client sponsors for funding approval. 
• Capture process metrics and prepare the Process Qualification / Assessment output, including pipeline prioritisation where multiple candidates compete for the same delivery capacity. 
• Use Process Mining and Task Mining outputs where available to validate stated process behaviour against actual system event data, rather than relying solely on stakeholder recall. 
• Conduct deep-dive "As-Is" analysis to design optimized "To-Be" states, ensuring processes are not just automated, but architected for peak efficiency. 
• Author comprehensive Process Design Documents (PDDs) and partner on Solution Designs (SDDs) to ensure absolute logic clarity and traceability. 
• Produce end-to-end process maps and flow diagrams (BPMN / Visio / Lucid), covering the happy path, every business exception, every system exception and the defined handling for each. 
• Define and baseline detailed functional and non-functional requirements, acceptance criteria, business rules, data dictionaries, input/output specifications and in-scope / out-of-scope boundaries; drive formal sign-off from the process owner before build begins. 
• Own the Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) so that every requirement is traceable through design, build, test case and production release. 
• Identify and document the AS-IS to TO-BE process re-engineering opportunities, eliminating waste before automating rather than automating an inefficient process as-is. 
• Contribute to pre-sales and solutioning activity - discovery for prospects, effort estimation and proposal input - where the account requires it. 
Deliverables Owned by This Role 
• Process Assessment / Qualification Document and automation business case with ROI model. 
• As-Is and To-Be process maps and detailed process flow diagrams. 
• Process Definition Document (PDD) and contribution to the Solution Design Document (SDD). 
• Functional and non-functional requirements specification with acceptance criteria and business rules. 
• Test strategy, test scenarios, test cases, UAT pack and signed UAT closure report. 
• Exception handling and business continuity procedure. 
• End-user training material, SOPs and user guides. 
• Support runbook, escalation matrix and knowledge-transfer pack for handover. 
• Post-implementation benefit realisation report. 
Must Have Qualifications: 
• 5+ years of Business Analysis experience with a dedicated focus on Intelligent Automation, RPA (e.g., UiPath), or AI-driven application engineering, including at least 2 years in a senior or lead analyst capacity. 
• Proven understanding of modern AI architectures, with the ability to design workflows that incorporate LLMs, API integrations, and unstructured data processing. 
• Demonstrable expertise in authoring rigorous PDDs and collaborating on SDDs with strict traceability. 
• Strong track record operating within Agile frameworks, serving as the definitive translation layer between executive business stakeholders and technical engineering pods. 
• Migration Fluency: Specific exposure to UiPath and/or Blue Prism. 
• Demonstrated end-to-end SDLC ownership: evidence of personally carrying at least three automation or AI initiatives from discovery through production deployment and hypercare, not only the documentation phase. 
Strong Plus: 
• UiPath Certified Professional Business Analyst (UiBPA). 
• Domain depth in Banking and Financial Services, particularly regulated processes with audit and control requirements. 
What We Offer 
• A truly international environment, collaborating on global automation projects. 
• The opportunity to experiment and innovate with Agentic AI solutions as we pioneer and rebrand our offering in the consultancy space 
• Work at the core of the automation and AI wave — we’re a pure-play automation company fully focused on innovation and future-ready solutions. 
• A growth-focused environment where you’re empowered to develop, excel, and contribute meaningfully — no corporate silos, no red tape. 
• This is not your standard corporate job — we value initiative over hierarchy, and you’ll have room to make a real impact from day one. 
• A vibrant team culture, collaborative spirit and culture you can’t experience anywhere else! 
 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
