title: Decision Analytics Manager
description:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
Job Description
The Business Intelligence & Analytics (BI&A) team has a simple mission: we turn massive amounts of data into actionable insights that ensure seamless, secure commerce experiences across Visa’s physical and digital eco-system. Our analytic and data professionals deliver on this mission by implementing data-based solutions, analysis, and insights targeted at maintaining security, reducing fraud rates, and preserving the integrity of the largest payment processing network in the world.
The Decision Analytics Manager works directly with key stakeholders, taking ownership of their strategic questions and using data and analytics to arrive at recommendations that drive better business outcomes. This isn’t a role for someone who can do a bit of both — it’s for someone genuinely excellent at both: technical enough to build the answer yourself, business-savvy enough to know it’s the right question in the first place, driven by genuine curiosity about the business behind every ask. This is an individual-contributor role with no direct reports — you choose the approach and tools yourself, including AI. The role has regular exposure to senior leaders across the organization.
Responsibilities
The Decision Analytics Manager role will take requests directly from stakeholders across the Global Risk organization, understand the business context behind each one, determine the right approach to answer it, and be personally accountable for delivering a recommendation that drives a better business outcome. This person is experienced in scoping an ambiguous ask quickly, choosing the right tool for the job (including AI), and knowing when a question needs more rigor than it was asked with. You must be able to deliver on strategic initiatives and influence outcomes independently, without a team to lean on.
• Approach every request with genuine curiosity about the business problem behind it — understanding what decision it supports before deciding on a method or a tool.
• Take requests directly from key stakeholders, clarify the real business question behind the ask, and determine the fastest credible approach to answer it.
• Own each request end to end — from the first conversation with the stakeholder through the final recommendation — without handing pieces of it off to a team.
• Use the best available tool for each question — SQL, Tableau/Power BI, AI-assisted coding tools such as Claude Code, or a combination — rather than defaulting to a standard dashboard or report.
• Build analyses that benchmark performance against peers or history (e.g., comparing an issuer's or acquirer's fraud and approval performance) to give stakeholders a credible frame of reference for a decision.
• Leverage data and analytics on fraud and dispute patterns to inform ecosystem security and integrity decisions, translating findings into a specific recommendation.
• Know when a question is bigger than it looks, and escalate or reframe it before you invest time answering the wrong thing.
• Serve as the subject matter expert stakeholders come to with a business problem, not just a request for data.
• Contribute to a high performing culture that becomes the benchmark for excellence at Visa by sharing your approach and judgment with other analysts in the function, even without a formal mentoring mandate.
• Move the organization from interesting to actionable — every piece of work should end in a recommendation that changes a decision, not just a finding.
• Craft the recommendations and presentations that carry them yourself, ensuring senior stakeholders get a clear answer and a clear “so what.”
• Champion the responsible use of AI tools in your own work — knowing when they speed up getting to an answer, and validating their output before it informs a decision.
• Cultivate relationships with stakeholders so they bring you the real question early, rather than a pre-formed request for a specific output.
Qualifications
Basic Qualifications:
• Genuine curiosity about the business behind the data — you ask why before you ask how, and you don't start building until you understand what decision the answer needs to support.
• 5 years of work experience with a bachelor’s degree, or 3 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g., Masters/MBA/JD/MD).
• Demonstrated ability to take an ambiguous business question from a stakeholder, scope it, and determine the right approach to answer it.
• Comfort owning a stakeholder relationship and a request end to end yourself, without a team to delegate pieces of the work to.
• Genuine, hands-on skill with AI-assisted tools (e.g., Claude Code, Microsoft Copilot, or similar), SQL, and visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI) — paired with the business judgment to know when and how to apply them. This role needs real strength in both, not one standing in for the other.
Preferred Qualifications
• 6+ years of progressive success in individual-contributor roles of increasing responsibility and visibility.
• 3+ years working in analytics, risk, management consulting, strategic operations or insight delivery, with direct exposure to senior stakeholders.
• Experience operating as a direct, individual point of contact for senior stakeholders in a matrixed, global organization.
• Track record of recommendations that changed a business decision, not just analyses that were delivered.
• Direct experience using Claude Code or similar agentic AI coding tools to get to an answer faster, including judgment on when not to.
• Excellent presentation and communication abilities, especially distilling a recommendation to its “so what.”
• Knowledge of Visa’s products, services, and client engagement strategies.
• Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal skills are required.
• Working familiarity with basic statistical techniques (e.g., trend and variance analysis) to sanity-check a finding before it goes to a stakeholder.
Visa is an EEO Employer
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
Roboyo AI is a category shaper in Applied AI and Agentic Automation. We help leading enterprises move from automation projects and AI experiments into governed, production-grade systems that execute real work across workflows, processes, products and services. 
Our heritage is in scaled enterprise automation; our future is Applied AI and Agentic Automation: autonomous agents, AI engineering squads, process orchestration, data and knowledge foundations, and human-in-the-loop governance embedded deeply into how our clients operate. 
We are not here to sell AI theatre. We are here to turn AI into working systems, measurable outcomes and repeatable transformation programs. 
 About the role
This is an end-to-end ownership role. The Senior Business Analyst (BSA) is accountable for the business-facing thread of an automation or AI initiative from first stakeholder conversation to post-production stabilisation. You will run process discovery and feasibility assessment, define and baseline requirements, partner with architects and developers through build, own functional and user acceptance testing, support go-live and hypercare, and hand over a fully documented, measurable solution to the client and support teams. You are expected to operate independently on complex processes, mentor junior analysts, and be the person the client trusts to tell them what is genuinely automatable and what is not. 
Key Responsibilities 
• Lead structured discovery workshops, stakeholder interviews, job shadowing and process walkthroughs with business SMEs to capture the true operating process, including exceptions, workarounds and undocumented tribal knowledge. 
• Perform automation feasibility and complexity assessment; qualify or disqualify candidate processes against standardisation, rule-clarity, volume, stability and data-quality criteria, and have the confidence to recommend against automation where the business case does not hold. 
• Build the business case: quantify AS-IS effort, volumes, FTE cost, error rates and cycle times; model expected benefit, ROI, payback period and effort estimate, and present it to client sponsors for funding approval. 
• Capture process metrics and prepare the Process Qualification / Assessment output, including pipeline prioritisation where multiple candidates compete for the same delivery capacity. 
• Use Process Mining and Task Mining outputs where available to validate stated process behaviour against actual system event data, rather than relying solely on stakeholder recall. 
• Conduct deep-dive "As-Is" analysis to design optimized "To-Be" states, ensuring processes are not just automated, but architected for peak efficiency. 
• Author comprehensive Process Design Documents (PDDs) and partner on Solution Designs (SDDs) to ensure absolute logic clarity and traceability. 
• Produce end-to-end process maps and flow diagrams (BPMN / Visio / Lucid), covering the happy path, every business exception, every system exception and the defined handling for each. 
• Define and baseline detailed functional and non-functional requirements, acceptance criteria, business rules, data dictionaries, input/output specifications and in-scope / out-of-scope boundaries; drive formal sign-off from the process owner before build begins. 
• Own the Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) so that every requirement is traceable through design, build, test case and production release. 
• Identify and document the AS-IS to TO-BE process re-engineering opportunities, eliminating waste before automating rather than automating an inefficient process as-is. 
• Contribute to pre-sales and solutioning activity - discovery for prospects, effort estimation and proposal input - where the account requires it. 
Deliverables Owned by This Role 
• Process Assessment / Qualification Document and automation business case with ROI model. 
• As-Is and To-Be process maps and detailed process flow diagrams. 
• Process Definition Document (PDD) and contribution to the Solution Design Document (SDD). 
• Functional and non-functional requirements specification with acceptance criteria and business rules. 
• Test strategy, test scenarios, test cases, UAT pack and signed UAT closure report. 
• Exception handling and business continuity procedure. 
• End-user training material, SOPs and user guides. 
• Support runbook, escalation matrix and knowledge-transfer pack for handover. 
• Post-implementation benefit realisation report. 
Must Have Qualifications: 
• 5+ years of Business Analysis experience with a dedicated focus on Intelligent Automation, RPA (e.g., UiPath), or AI-driven application engineering, including at least 2 years in a senior or lead analyst capacity. 
• Proven understanding of modern AI architectures, with the ability to design workflows that incorporate LLMs, API integrations, and unstructured data processing. 
• Demonstrable expertise in authoring rigorous PDDs and collaborating on SDDs with strict traceability. 
• Strong track record operating within Agile frameworks, serving as the definitive translation layer between executive business stakeholders and technical engineering pods. 
• Migration Fluency: Specific exposure to UiPath and/or Blue Prism. 
• Demonstrated end-to-end SDLC ownership: evidence of personally carrying at least three automation or AI initiatives from discovery through production deployment and hypercare, not only the documentation phase. 
Strong Plus: 
• UiPath Certified Professional Business Analyst (UiBPA). 
• Domain depth in Banking and Financial Services, particularly regulated processes with audit and control requirements. 
What We Offer 
• A truly international environment, collaborating on global automation projects. 
• The opportunity to experiment and innovate with Agentic AI solutions as we pioneer and rebrand our offering in the consultancy space 
• Work at the core of the automation and AI wave — we’re a pure-play automation company fully focused on innovation and future-ready solutions. 
• A growth-focused environment where you’re empowered to develop, excel, and contribute meaningfully — no corporate silos, no red tape. 
• This is not your standard corporate job — we value initiative over hierarchy, and you’ll have room to make a real impact from day one. 
• A vibrant team culture, collaborative spirit and culture you can’t experience anywhere else! 
 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Your work will make history and help millions of lives each day come together around the joys of food and inspire their well-being.
Senior Technical Program Manager – AI
Position Summary:
The Technical Program Manager should have a background leading and managing complex enterprise technical programs with cross-functional technical and business teams. The role interfaces with executive leadership and key business partners, identifies and mitigates risks, and ensures regulatory compliance. Candidates must have personally led enterprise AI-first transformation / AI enablement and adoption with proven, evidenced results, from prioritization and experimentation through production, scaling, and continuous improvement. 
Key Responsibilities: 
• End-to-end AI delivery: Lead AI initiatives from use-case prioritization and experimentation through production deployment, scaling, ways of working, continuous improvement, change management including and not limited to driving AI Upskilling efforts etc. 
• Program leadership & delivery: Lead and manage multiple complex programs with urgency; develop plans, track progress, set clear accountability and timelines, and lead ad hoc special projects for the leadership team. Apply Agile and other fit-for-purpose delivery approaches as appropriate. 
• Measurable outcomes: Define and track outcomes such as adoption, productivity or cycle-time improvement, quality, risk reduction, and realized business value; use evidence to communicate impact. 
• Executive & enterprise stakeholder engagement: T09 – interface with executive-level management for support, status, and issues; T10 – serve as a core spokesperson, highly influential with senior and executive leaders & cross-functional teams. Both levels develop recommendations and presentations for SLT leadership. 
• Strategy and change: T09 – anticipate challenges, recommend new processes, standards, or operational plans, and contribute to functional strategy. T10 – Proactively identify and solve the most complex problems impacting business management and direction, with broad latitude to apply judgment and discretion. 
• Influence and conflict resolution: Provide thought leadership to SLT leadership; align stakeholders without direct authority; resolve cross-team conflicts on priorities, dependencies, and resources; influence senior and executive leaders on short- and long-term issues. 
• Planning and financial ownership: Own program planning, budget, resource and financial planning, tracking, reporting, and risk assessment. 
• Responsible AI and operational readiness: Partner with relevant teams to address responsible AI, privacy, security, regulatory compliance, model evaluation, and production monitoring. 
• Best practices and people: T09 – adopt existing Program Management best practices. T10 – identify and develop them, facilitate continuous improvement and cross-organization events. Both levels mentor, develop, and train TPMs and comply with regulatory directives. 
Qualifications – Must Have:
• PMO - Strong experience working with or within a PMO
• Significant global offshore/onshore experience; Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, Excel, or other PM tools , using AI tools for effective & efficient Program Management; lead ambiguous, complex situations to measurable plans; facilitate continuous improvement and cross-organization events; collaborate in a matrix/virtual environment; experience with external vendors management
•  Strong Documentation and knowledge management best practices
•  AI First (required, both levels) Personally led enterprise AI-first transformation / AI enablement and adoption in a current or previous company, with evidenced results
•  AI delivery and approaches - End-to-end AI delivery from use-case prioritization and experimentation through production deployment, scaling, and continuous improvement; experience with Agile and other suitable delivery approaches
• Also required at both levels Enterprise transformation experience; influence without authority; cross-team conflict resolution; demonstrated strategic influence at SLT / executive level. Contribution, planning, or support roles alone do not meet the AI First requirement. Well-organized, detail-oriented, strong communicator, thrives in a fast-paced environment.
Education:
Bachelor’s degree, specialized training, or relevant professional qualification. 
Competencies: Program management (planning, budget, resource and financial planning, risk); communication and cross-functional leadership; mentoring TPMs; compassionate, inclusive, learning-focused, strategic thinking, customer focus, and consistent delivery of results with tangible metrics. Learning-focused, finding ways to improve in their field and using positive constructive feedback to grow personally and professionally. 
Preferred: Hands-on use of AI tools for program management is a plus.

title: Principal Technical Program Manager
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
• Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
An Overview Of This Role
As a Technical Program Manager on GitLab's all-remote R&D PMO team, you will own complex, end-to-end programs that are central to our AI-powered DevSecOps strategy. You will drive high-priority initiatives across product, engineering, data, and security teams, transforming strategic vision into executable plans that deliver innovative capabilities like the GitLab Duo Agent Platform and next-generation developer tools. You will work closely with executive leaders and cross-functional stakeholders, serving as the bridge between strategy and execution through clear communication, proactive risk management, and structured program delivery. In your first year, you will independently lead strategic programs, driving predictable execution, thoughtful tradeoffs between quality and speed, and transparent stakeholder alignment.
Some Examples Of Our Projects
• Leading the GitLab Duo Agent Platform from GA through enterprise adoption, including customer onboarding, support models, and billing integration for AI-driven capabilities
• Delivering data-intensive platform initiatives that enhance developer productivity and enterprise analytics capabilities
• Driving infrastructure modernization and scalability programs that support our growing customer base
• Orchestrating security and compliance initiatives that maintain our industry-leading DevSecOps standards
What You Will Do
• Lead end-to-end technical programs across product, engineering, data, and security, from initial scope through launch and continuous improvement
• Collaborate closely with executive leaders and senior stakeholders to translate strategic vision into actionable roadmaps and align on priorities and tradeoffs
• Coordinate distributed teams across time zones using strong asynchronous communication, providing structure, clarity, and consistent status updates
• Develop and maintain comprehensive program plans, proactively identifying and mitigating risks and dependencies while facilitating decisions that balance speed, quality, and customer impact
• Partner with customer success and cross-functional teams to refine communication plans, and operational workflows
• Champion GitLab's values and culture within programs, fostering collaborative excellence, continuous improvement, and innovation
What You Will Bring
• Proven experience leading technical program initiatives in product, engineering, data, or security environments, with demonstrated success delivering complex programs from inception through scaled adoption
• Demonstrated ability to define strategy and create clarity within extreme ambiguity
• Strong background in SaaS, cloud infrastructure, or DevOps technology companies, with ability to quickly master the GitLab platform and AI/ML initiatives
• Proven experience influencing and driving impact at a division and company-wide scale, affecting market position and revenue
• Excellence in cross-functional leadership, with experience partnering with engineering, product, security teams and engaging effectively with senior and C-level stakeholders
• Outstanding communication skills, including asynchronous collaboration, executive reporting, and the ability to translate technical complexity into clear business impact
• Track record of success in fast-paced, dynamic environments with evolving technical requirements and market opportunities
• Strong facilitation and influence skills, with ability to drive consensus across diverse stakeholder groups while building trust through transparency and delivery excellence
• Expertise in high-level stakeholder management, including masterful communication with Executive Boards and enterprise Customers
• Collaborative leadership style aligned with GitLab's values, including respect, openness to feedback, and commitment to team success
• Proven track record of redefining organizational operations and serving as an escalation point to resolve highly complex, enterprise-level challenges
• Welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds, including those with consulting, enterprise technology, or technical leadership experience who have owned outcomes and delivered transformational initiatives
• Ability to act as a visionary leader, shaping R&D direction and fostering technical excellence across the organization
About the team: The Technical Program Management team sits within GitLab's R&D Program Management Office and drives product, engineering, data, and security initiatives across our AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You will join our growing, distributed team of Technical Program Managers currently spanning North America and Europe. We own the end-to-end delivery of complex, cross-functional programs including AI platform capabilities, enterprise customer initiatives, and strategic technology transformations. As an all-remote team, we excel at asynchronous communication to coordinate across time zones while partnering closely with executive leaders and stakeholders to deliver business-critical outcomes.

description:
Overview
Working at Atlassian
Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
Responsibilities
The Analytics Platform is Atlassian’s AI-ready data backbone, enabling trusted analytics across cloud environments while simplifying the underlying architecture to make data reliable, discoverable, and cost-effective at scale. By unifying a consistent data foundation, low-latency analytics, and governed access patterns, it helps both people and AI agents move from raw data to self-service insights faster and with greater confidence. The Analytics Platform is the data platform foundation for AI-native experiences such as intelligent assistants, embedded analytics, faster time to first query, and future ML use cases while preserving the reliability, permissions, and metric integrity required for enterprise-grade decision-making.

title: Senior Manager, AI Program Management , Pragati AI for Impact
description:
About The/Nudge
The/Nudge is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals, and youth across rural development, agriculture, skilling, and economic inclusion, in partnership with 15+ central and state governments.
Our economic inclusion journey towards serving 25 million Indians spans 10 states and currently reaches over 1.5 million people. Through our incubator, accelerator, and grand challenges, we have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs, including Forbes 30 Under 30 honorees, Earthshot Prize winners, and nationally recognized changemakers.
Founded with the support of 130+ eminent philanthropists, 40+ corporates, and 15+ foundations, The/Nudge is working towards a poverty-free India, within our lifetime.
Pragati: AI and Tech for Impact 
The Pragati AI for Impact initiative, backed by Meta, supports nonprofits in leveraging AI to address critical social challenges in areas such as employability and skilling, education, climate change and health. We fund pilot projects and scaling initiatives, seek measurable outcomes, and emphasise financial sustainability, ethical AI practices and inclusive design.
Over the next few years, we aim to enable development of scalable, ethical, and inclusive AI and tech solutions that deliver measurable impact, empowering underserved communities and contributing to sustainable development across the nation.
Read about Pragati AI for impact here
Role Overview

In this role, you will serve as the operational backbone of the program, ensuring seamless execution by connecting various stakeholders, managing timelines, and facilitating communication. Your ability to navigate and connect different players and initiatives within the ecosystem will be crucial to driving the program's success.
This role blends product thinking, program execution, technical problem-solving and stakeholder management, and is ideal for an experienced program manager from a start up or innovation-focussed team who is curious, keeps abreast of the latest developments in AI and technology, and is eager to apply their skills to driving social impact.
What will you do? 
•  Program Owner, Coordination & Execution

•  Stakeholder Management & Partnerships
• Build Partnerships: Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with cohort members, AI/tech partners, funders, and ecosystem actors.
• Coordinate Capacity-Building: Organize orientation sessions, workshops, and peer-learning platforms to enhance cohort members’ capabilities.
• Understand the Ecosystem: Map and connect stakeholders, initiatives, and resources across the AI-for-impact landscape to ensure aligned, impactful outcomes.
• Amplify the Program: Become a SME and advocate for the program at external events, conferences, and forums, showcasing its impact and fostering new partnerships.
•  M&E & Academic Partner Coordination
• Oversee M&E Partner: Ensure the Monitoring & Evaluation partner is effectively executing their oversight role, maintaining accountability, and providing accurate, timely insights on pilot performance and impact.
• Coordinate with Technical/Academic Partner: Ensure the technical/academic partner is available to provide guidance, insights, and recommendations to cohort members as needed, supporting them when they seek expert input.
•  Learning, Impact & Communication
• Analyze Data & Generate Insights: Collect and review project data to inform program strategies and continuous improvement.
• Document Learnings: Prepare reports, case studies, and presentations for internal teams, funders, and the broader ecosystem.
• Ensure Ethical Practices: Promote ethical AI practices, data governance, and inclusive design across cohort projects
Who are we looking for in this role? 
• 10-12 years of program management experience in Technology and AI product domain, ideally in startups or innovation-driven teams.
• Proven experience leading programs in engineering/product functions.
• Strong understanding of AI/ML systems, digital platforms, and building in complex, real-world environments.
• Curious and up-to-date on emerging AI and technology trends.
• Able to engage at a conceptual level to support problem-solving and technical discussions.
• Strategic thinker with hands-on problem-solving ability.
• Skilled at managing multiple projects and coordinating diverse stakeholders.
• Effective collaborator and communicator across technical and mission-driven teams.
• Strong analytical skills and commitment to ethical, inclusive technology.
• Experience in the social impact or nonprofit space is an advantage, though not essential for candidates who are mission-aligned and eager to engage deeply.
What’s in it for you? 
Own your growth: An impact-led learning environment encourages Nudgesters to invest in their learning and capacity building needs through initiatives and policies, including L&D wallet, individual development plan and internal role change opportunities.
Find your tribe: Our hiring philosophy emphasises intent, attitude, smarts and skills, in that order, to build a cohesive environment for Nudgesters. The organisation is committed to curating people-centric policies, enhancing how employees experience life at The/Nudge.
Take big bets: Organisational initiatives are intended to facilitate Nudgesters with a view to the big picture, illustrated by our impact across 50000+ households, 15+ governments, 200+ social enterprises and Charcha: India’s largest social sector convening forum.
Make it happen: A product-based approach in an action-biased environment empowers Nudgesters to implement audacious plans. Driven to fail fast, we endeavour to optimise resources in favour of programs that align with our scale ambition.
We aspire to be an inclusive and diverse organization and encourage qualified individuals irrespective of their religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, or any other dimension of identity, to apply

title: Sr Technical Program Manager, Selection Monitoring
description:

In this role, you will drive and deliver complex, cross-functional technical programs that are critical to the selection discovery and extraction components of Amazon's Selection Gap Closure and World Product Catalog (WPC) initiatives. You will operate at the intersection of multiple two-pizza teams (2PTs) and collaborate closely with external stakeholders to ensure seamless execution of large-scale programs. The systems you will work across leverage Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) extensively for information extraction, content understanding, and intelligent automation — and a key outcome of your work will be reducing Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) dependencies to enable fully autonomous, scalable operations.
Key job responsibilities
•  Program Leadership: Own and drive end-to-end delivery of complex technical projects spanning multiple 2PTs across SDO, ensuring alignment on goals, timelines, and dependencies

•  HITL Reduction & Automation: Drive programs that systematically reduce Human-in-the-Loop interventions by leveraging GenAI/LLM capabilities, enabling the organization to scale operations without proportional headcount growth
•  Selection Gap Closure – Discovery & Extraction: Drive the selection discovery and extraction workstreams that feed into the broader Selection Gap Closure program, including source identification, web crawling, and product data extraction from off-Amazon websites World Product Catalog (WPC) – Discovery
•  Extraction: Own the SDO-scoped delivery of WPC's selection discovery and extraction pipeline — ensuring product data is reliably discovered, crawled, and extracted at scale to feed downstream ASIN creation and catalog enrichment systems
•  GenAI/LLM Program Delivery: Coordinate the development and deployment of LLM-powered solutions across the selection discovery pipeline — including autonomous web navigation, intelligent content extraction, and automated data transformation
•  Stakeholder Management: Communicate program status, risks, and milestones to senior leadership and cross-functional partners; influence without authority to drive outcomes across teams
•  Operational Excellence: Establish and maintain program mechanisms (e.g., status reviews, risk registers, dependency tracking) to ensure predictable delivery and early identification of issues
•  Scaling & Automation: Identify opportunities to improve program efficiency through better tooling, AI-driven automation, and process optimization across data pipelines and orchestration workflows

•  5+ years of technical product or program management experience
•  5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
•  Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
•  Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent
Preferred Qualifications
•  5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
•  Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
•  Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

title: Program and Delivery Manager - AI and Data Delivery

Working closely with the System Architect, Enterprise Architecture and Cyber Security, the role ensures that solutions handling sensitive employee and legal information meet Eaton architecture, privacy and security standards. The position also serves as secondary owner of the AI Navigator idea-to-disposition process for ideas raised by these functions.

•  Act as secondary owner for AI Navigator idea-to-disposition for ideas originating in HR, Legal and Corporate Development, ensuring each idea is assessed, dispositioned and tracked to closure.
•  Build and manage the financial plan for the portfolio, including annual budget, project and run forecasting, platform consumption, contractor cost control and variance reporting.
•  Partner with the System Architect, Enterprise Architecture and Cyber Security so that solutions comply with architecture guardrails, data privacy obligations and information security standards applicable to employee and legal data.
•  Establish and operate delivery governance, covering status reporting, risk and issue management, dependency management, change control and steering reviews.
•  Drive adoption of Agile delivery practices and improve predictability, cycle time and quality through objective delivery metrics.

title: Program Manager II, Risk Mining, Account Integrity
description:
Description
Amazon's Account Integrity Team (AIT) within Buyer Risk Prevention (BRP) protects hundreds of millions of customers by identifying and stopping fraudulent activity before it causes harm. The Risk Mining function is where human ingenuity meets machine learning - our team detects emerging modus operandi (MOs) that automated systems alone can't catch, and feeds those signals back into scalable upstream defenses. If you want your program management skills to directly translate into customer trust at global scale, this is the team.
The Program Manager (PM II) will own the operational rhythm and cross-functional coordination for Risk Mining across four verticals spanning India and Costa Rica. This is a role where you will have real ownership from day one - partnering with Risk Mining leadership to scope processes, define goals, build reporting mechanisms, and drive delivery against them. You will work with a high degree of autonomy, collaborating across Engineering, Machine Learning, Product, and partner risk teams to improve workflows, champion AI-enabled solutions, and deliver measurable gains in detection speed, quality, and operational efficiency.
This is an execution-focused role with broad cross-team influence, reporting to the Risk Mining leadership team. The PM is accountable for scoping processes, owning the operating cadence, driving programs to delivery, mitigating risk, and clearing blockers.
Key job responsibilities
•  Operating Cadence & Reporting
•  Own Weekly Program Review (WPR) and Quarterly Program Review (QPR) reporting for the Risk Mining function, ensuring data accuracy, timely delivery, and clear path-to-green commentary on key goals.
•  Own Flash preparation and build a self-sustaining reporting rhythm where leadership always has an accurate, on-time view of the org.
•  Track and drive closure of action items stemming from business reviews and COE findings.
•  Accelerate progress by driving crisp, timely decisions, identifying and clearing blockers, and escalating appropriately.
•  Cross-Team Collaboration & Standardization
•  Drive cross-RM initiatives with Payment Risk (PRISM-I) and Abuse Risk Mining (ARM) teams.
•  Serve as the operational point of contact for joint MO investigations and deep dives.
•  Lead coordination and sync between India and Costa Rica sites to reduce operational drift across verticals.
•  Standardize processes, tooling, and communication cadences across all Risk Mining verticals to ensure consistent quality and velocity.
•  Own the program for feedback loops from Risk Mining MOs back into ML, Engineering, and Product teams.
•  SOP Governance & Audit-Readiness
•  Lead SOP lifecycle management - author, review, deploy, and ensure parity or superiority of SOPs across BRP.
•  Keep SOPs audit-ready with periodic reviews and documentation updates tied to policy changes.
•  Manage the goals document and quarterly planning cycles to keep the team aligned with org-level priorities.
•  Drive efficiency in rule management - create paths to offline monitoring, and partner with ML teams on rule lifecycle.
•  Innovation & GenAI Enablement
•  Identify automation and GenAI opportunities within Risk Mining workflows.
•  Reduce manual effort and improve throughput and quality in MO identification, triage, and reporting.
•  Partner with Engineering, ML, and Product teams to pilot and adopt AI-assisted workflows across Risk Mining operations.
•  Develop the RM MO Repository - a scalable knowledge base of modus operandi patterns for reuse across AIT and partner teams.
•  Propose and implement programs such as Hackathons, Innovation Workshops, and AI Proficiency sprints.
•  Establish mechanisms to measure realized ROI from AI investments.
•  ML & Engineering Intake & Prioritization
•  Own the ML and Engineering intake mechanism with AIT and IDS engineering teams.
•  Ensure the team's highest-value asks are consistently landed, not stuck in ad-hoc queues.
•  Lead OP1 planning - build intake processes within Risk Mining that produce scalable, long-term roadmap ideas.
•  Enable prioritization of requirements with Engineering and ML partners.
•  Own communications for new tool rollouts to ensure smooth adoption across all verticals and sites.
•  Escalation Management
•  Single point of contact for all escalation action items - Sev-2 tickets, executive escalations, and COE action items.
•  Manage prioritization and tracking of external requests from partner teams on MO investigations and deep dives.
•  Ensure operational readiness for process changes, transitions, and high-severity incident response.
A day in the life
Your week will blend tactical execution with strategic thinking - no two days look identical, but here's the rhythm:
Tactical (Keeping the Engine Running)
•  Follow up on ageing Risk Mining tickets, drive root-cause analysis, and close action items.
•  Report out metrics and path-to-green on key goals in WBR and WPR forums.
•  Follow up on Rule Governance action items, SEV-2 reduction efforts, and audit readiness reviews.
•  Coordinate with cross-site teams (India and Costa Rica) to ensure consistent execution and information flow.
•  Participate in weekly project stand-ups and initiative check-ins.
Strategic (Building What's Next)
•  Participate in GenAI and Innovation forums to identify and champion automation opportunities across Risk Mining workflows.
•  Join Engineering and ML connects to stay close to the technical roadmap and drive intake priorities.
•  Facilitate cross-functional partner connects - collaborating with Payment Risk, Abuse Risk Mining, and broader BRP stakeholders on joint MO investigations and risk signals.
•  Prepare documents for weekly and quarterly reviews, metric deep-dives, and OP1 planning cycles.
•  Drive new project kick-offs and workshops with ML, Engineering, and Product partners.
About The Team
The Risk Mining team within Account Integrity spans India and Costa Rica, and works for Amazon's worldwide marketplace to detect and disrupt bad-actor behavior. We are analysts, investigators, and builders - using a powerful combination of analytics, code, GenAI tools, and deep-dive investigations to uncover fraud patterns that automated systems alone can't catch.
Our mission is simple: find the signal in the noise before bad actors cause harm. We partner closely with Machine Learning, Engineering, and Product teams to turn our investigative findings into scalable upstream defenses. The team operates across four risk verticals: Anti-Automation, Account Takeover, SMS Pumping, and Bad Actor Account - and collaborates with Payment Risk and Abuse Risk Mining teams across Buyer Risk Prevention (BRP) to drive end-to-end fraud mitigation.
If you want to work where your program management skills directly translate into customer trust at global scale, this is the team.
Basic Qualifications
•  5+ years of program or project management experience
•  3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
•  3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
•  Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
•  Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
Preferred Qualifications
•  3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
•  3+ years of driving process improvements experience
•  Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
•  Experience driving AI/automation-enabled process improvements, with a strong interest in applying GenAI to operational workflows.
